transliteration: indriyaei paraey ahur indriyebhyau paraa manau manasas tu para buddhir yo buddheu paratas tu sau
translation: The working senses are superior to dull matter; mind is higher than the senses; intelligence is still higher than the mind; and he [the soul] is even higher than the intelligence.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: evaà buddheù paraà buddhvä saàstabhyätmänam ätmanä jahi çatruà mahä-bäho käma-rüpaà duräsadam
transliteration: evaa buddheu paraa buddhva saastabhyatmanam atmana jahi catrua maha-baho kama-rupaa durasadam
translation: Thus knowing oneself to be transcendental to material senses, mind and intelligence, one should control the lower self by the higher self and thus—by spiritual strength—conquer this insatiable enemy known as lust.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çré-bhagavän uväca imaà vivasvate yogaà proktavän aham avyayam vivasvän manave präha manur ikñväkave ’bravét
transliteration: cre-bhagavan uvaca imaa vivasvate yogaa proktavan aham avyayam vivasvan manave praha manur iknvakave 'bravet
translation: The Blessed Lord said: I instructed this imperishable science of yoga to the sungod, Vivasvän, and Vivasvän instructed it to Manu, the father of mankind, and Manu in turn instructed it to Ikñväku.

glossary.gloss: the Supreme Personality of Godhead said
the science of one’s relationship to the Supreme
unto the father of mankind (of the name Vaivasvata)

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: evaà paramparä-präptam imaà räjarñayo viduù sa käleneha mahatä yogo nañöaù parantapa
transliteration: evaa parampara-praptam imaa rajarnayo viduu sa kaleneha mahata yogo nanoau parantapa
translation: This supreme science was thus received through the chain of disciplic succession, and the saintly kings understood it in that way. But in course of time the succession was broken, and therefore the science as it is appears to be lost.

glossary.gloss: the science of one’s relationship with the Supreme

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sa eväyaà mayä te ’dya yogaù proktaù purätanaù bhakto ’si me sakhä ceti rahasyaà hy etad uttamam
transliteration: sa evayaa maya te 'dya yogau proktau puratanau bhakto 'si me sakha ceti rahasyaa hy etad uttamam
translation: That very ancient science of the relationship with the Supreme is today told by Me to you because you are My devotee as well as My friend; therefore you can understand the transcendental mystery of this science.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: arjuna uväca aparaà bhavato janma paraà janma vivasvataù katham etad vijänéyäà tvam ädau proktavän iti
transliteration: arjuna uvaca aparaa bhavato janma paraa janma vivasvatau katham etad vijaneyaa tvam adau proktavan iti
translation: Arjuna said: The sun-god Vivasvän is senior by birth to You. How am I to understand that in the beginning You instructed this science to him?
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çré-bhagavän uväca bahüni me vyatétäni janmäni tava cärjuna täny ahaà veda sarväëi na tvaà vettha parantapa
transliteration: cre-bhagavan uvaca bahuni me vyatetani janmani tava carjuna tany ahaa veda sarvaei na tvaa vettha parantapa
translation: The Blessed Lord said: Many, many births both you and I have passed. I can remember all of them, but you cannot, O subduer of the enemy!
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ajo ’pi sann avyayätmä bhütänäm éçvaro ’pi san prakåtià sväm adhiñöhäya sambhavämy ätma-mäyayä
transliteration: ajo 'pi sann avyayatma bhutanam ecvaro 'pi san prakatia svam adhinohaya sambhavamy atma-mayaya
translation: Although I am unborn and My transcendental body never deteriorates, and although I am the Lord of all sentient beings, I still appear in every millennium in My original transcendental form.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yadä yadä hi dharmasya glänir bhavati bhärata abhyutthänam adharmasya tadätmänaà såjämy aham
transliteration: yada yada hi dharmasya glanir bhavati bharata abhyutthanam adharmasya tadatmanaa sajamy aham
translation: Whenever and wherever there is a decline in religious practice, O descendant of Bharata, and a predominant rise of irreligion—at that time I descend Myself.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: pariträëäya sädhünäà vinäçäya ca duñkåtäm dharma-saàsthäpanärthäya sambhavämi yuge yuge
transliteration: paritraeaya sadhunaa vinacaya ca dunkatam dharma-saasthapanarthaya sambhavami yuge yuge
translation: In order to deliver the pious and to annihilate the miscreants, as well as to reestablish the principles of religion, I advent Myself millennium after millennium.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: janma karma ca me divyam evaà yo vetti tattvataù tyaktvä dehaà punar janma naiti mäm eti so ’rjuna
transliteration: janma karma ca me divyam evaa yo vetti tattvatau tyaktva dehaa punar janma naiti mam eti so 'rjuna
translation: One who knows the transcendental nature of My appearance and activities does not, upon leaving the body, take his birth again in this material world, but attains My eternal abode, O Arjuna.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: véta-räga-bhaya-krodhä man-mayä mäm upäçritäù bahavo jïäna-tapasä pütä mad-bhävam ägatäù
transliteration: veta-raga-bhaya-krodha man-maya mam upacritau bahavo jiana-tapasa puta mad-bhavam agatau
translation: Being freed from attachment, fear and anger, being fully absorbed in Me and taking refuge in Me, many, many persons in the past became purifled by knowledge of Me—and thus they all attained transcendental love for Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ye yathä mäà prapadyante täàs tathaiva bhajämy aham mama vartmänuvartante manuñyäù pärtha sarvaçaù
transliteration: ye yatha maa prapadyante taas tathaiva bhajamy aham mama vartmanuvartante manunyau partha sarvacau
translation: All of them—as they surrender unto Me—I reward accordingly. Everyone follows My path in all respects, O son of Påthä.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: käìkñantaù karmaëäà siddhià yajanta iha devatäù kñipraà hi mänuñe loke siddhir bhavati karma-jä
transliteration: kaiknantau karmaeaa siddhia yajanta iha devatau knipraa hi manune loke siddhir bhavati karma-ja
translation: Men in this world desire success in fruitive activities, and therefore they worship the demigods. Quickly, of course, men get results from fruitive work in this world.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: cätur-varëyaà mayä såñöaà guëa-karma-vibhägaçaù tasya kartäram api mäà viddhy akartäram avyayam
transliteration: catur-vareyaa maya sanoaa guea-karma-vibhagacau tasya kartaram api maa viddhy akartaram avyayam
translation: According to the three modes of material nature and the work ascribed to them, the four divisions of human society were created by Me. And, although I am the creator of this system, you should know that I am yet the non-doer, being unchangeable.

glossary.gloss: the four divisions of human society

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: na mäà karmäëi limpanti na me karma-phale spåhä iti mäà yo ’bhijänäti karmabhir na sa badhyate
transliteration: na maa karmaei limpanti na me karma-phale spaha iti maa yo 'bhijanati karmabhir na sa badhyate
translation: There is no work that affects Me; nor do I aspire for the fruits of action. One who understands this truth about Me also does not become entangled in the fruitive reactions of work.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: evaà jïätvä kåtaà karma pürvair api mumukñubhiù kuru karmaiva tasmät tvaà pürvaiù pürvataraà kåtam
transliteration: evaa jiatva kataa karma purvair api mumuknubhiu kuru karmaiva tasmat tvaa purvaiu purvataraa katam
translation: All the liberated souls in ancient times acted with this understanding and so attained liberation. Therefore, as the ancients, you should perform your duty in this divine consciousness.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: kià karma kim akarmeti kavayo ’py atra mohitäù tat te karma pravakñyämi yaj jïätvä mokñyase ’çubhät
transliteration: kia karma kim akarmeti kavayo 'py atra mohitau tat te karma pravaknyami yaj jiatva moknyase 'cubhat
translation: Even the intelligent are bewildered in determining what is action and what is inaction. Now I shall explain to you what action is, knowing which you shall be liberated from all sins.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: karmaëo hy api boddhavyaà boddhavyaà ca vikarmaëaù akarmaëaç ca boddhavyaà gahanä karmaëo gatiù
transliteration: karmaeo hy api boddhavyaa boddhavyaa ca vikarmaeau akarmaeac ca boddhavyaa gahana karmaeo gatiu
translation: The intricacies of action are very hard to understand. Therefore one should know properly what action is, what forbidden action is, and what inaction is.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: karmaëy akarma yaù paçyed akarmaëi ca karma yaù sa buddhimän manuñyeñu sa yuktaù kåtsna-karma-kåt
transliteration: karmaey akarma yau pacyed akarmaei ca karma yau sa buddhiman manunyenu sa yuktau katsna-karma-kat
translation: One who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is intelligent among men, and he is in the tranecendental position, although engaged in all sorts of activities.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yasya sarve samärambhäù käma-saìkalpa-varjitäù jïänägni-dagdha-karmäëaà tam ähuù paëòitaà budhäù
transliteration: yasya sarve samarambhau kama-saikalpa-varjitau jianagni-dagdha-karmaeaa tam ahuu paeoitaa budhau
translation: One is understood to be in full knowledge whose every act is devoid of desire for sense gratification. He is said by sages to be a worker whose fruitive action is burned up by the fire of perfect knowledge.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: tyaktvä karma-phaläsaìgaà nitya-tåpto niräçrayaù karmaëy abhipravåtto ’pi naiva kiïcit karoti saù
transliteration: tyaktva karma-phalasaigaa nitya-tapto niracrayau karmaey abhipravatto 'pi naiva kiicit karoti sau
translation: Abandoning all attachment to the results of his activities, ever satisfied and independant, he performs no fruitive action, although engaged in all kinds of undertakings.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: niräçér yata-cittätmä tyakta-sarva-parigrahaù çäréraà kevalaà karma kurvan näpnoti kilbiñam
transliteration: niracer yata-cittatma tyakta-sarva-parigrahau careraa kevalaa karma kurvan napnoti kilbinam
translation: Such a man of understanding acts with mind and intelligence perfectly controlled, gives up all sense of proprietorship over his possessions and acts only for the bare necessities of life. Thus working, he is not affected by sinful reactions.

glossary.gloss: sense of proprietorship over all possessions
in keeping body and soul together

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yadåcchä-läbha-santuñöo dvandvätéto vimatsaraù samaù siddhäv asiddhau ca kåtväpi na nibadhyate
transliteration: yadaccha-labha-santunoo dvandvateto vimatsarau samau siddhav asiddhau ca katvapi na nibadhyate
translation: He who is satisfied with gain which comes of its own accord, who is free from duality and does not envy, who is steady both in success and failure, is never entangled, although performing actions.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: gata-saìgasya muktasya jïänävasthita-cetasaù yajïäyäcarataù karma samagraà praviléyate
transliteration: gata-saigasya muktasya jianavasthita-cetasau yajiayacaratau karma samagraa pravileyate
translation: The work of a man who is unattached to the modes of material nature and who is fully situated in transcendental knowledge merges entirely into transcendence.

glossary.gloss: unattached to the modes of material nature

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: brahmärpaëaà brahma havir brahmägnau brahmaëä hutam brahmaiva tena gantavyaà brahma-karma-samädhinä
transliteration: brahmarpaeaa brahma havir brahmagnau brahmaea hutam brahmaiva tena gantavyaa brahma-karma-samadhina
translation: A person who is fully absorbed in Kåñëa consciousness is sure to attain the spiritual kingdom because of his full contribution to spiritual activities, in which the consummation is absolute and that which is offered is of the same spiritual nature.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: daivam eväpare yajïaà yoginaù paryupäsate brahmägnäv apare yajïaà yajïenaivopajuhvati
transliteration: daivam evapare yajiaa yoginau paryupasate brahmagnav apare yajiaa yajienaivopajuhvati
translation: Some yogés perfectly worship the demigods by offering different sacrifices to them, and some of them offer sacrifices in the fire of the Supreme Brahman.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çroträdénéndriyäëy anye saàyamägniñu juhvati çabdädén viñayän anya indriyägniñu juhvati
transliteration: crotradenendriyaey anye saayamagninu juhvati cabdaden vinayan anya indriyagninu juhvati
translation: Some of them sacrifice the hearing process and the senses in the fire of the controlled mind, and others sacrifice the objects of the senses, such as sound, in the fire of sacrifice.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sarväëéndriya-karmäëi präëa-karmäëi cäpare ätma-saàyama-yogägnau juhvati jïäna-dépite
transliteration: sarvaeendriya-karmaei praea-karmaei capare atma-saayama-yogagnau juhvati jiana-depite
translation: Those who are interested in self-realization, in terms of mind and sense control, offer the functions of all the senses, as well as the vital force [breath], as oblations into the fire of the controlled mind.

glossary.gloss: because of the urge for self-realization.

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: dravya-yajïäs tapo-yajïä yoga-yajïäs tathäpare svädhyäya-jïäna-yajïäç ca yatayaù saàçita-vratäù
transliteration: dravya-yajias tapo-yajia yoga-yajias tathapare svadhyaya-jiana-yajiac ca yatayau saacita-vratau
translation: There are others who, enlightened by sacrificing their material possessions in severe austerities, take strict vows and practice the yoga of eightfold mysticism, and others study the Vedas for the advancement of transcendental knowledge.

glossary.gloss: sacrifice in the study of the Vedas
sacrifice in advancement of transcendental knowledge

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: apäne juhvati präëaà präëe ’pänaà tathäpare präëäpäna-gaté ruddhvä präëäyäma-paräyaëäù apare niyatähäräù präëän präëeñu juhvati
transliteration: apane juhvati praeaa praee 'panaa tathapare praeapana-gate ruddhva praeayama-parayaeau apare niyataharau praean praeenu juhvati
translation: And there are even others who are inclined to the process of breath restraint to remain in trance, and they practice stopping the movement of the outgoing breath into the incoming, and incoming breath into the outgoing, and thus at last remain in trance, stopping all breathing. Some of them, curtailing the eating process, offer the outgoing breath into itself, as a sacrifice.

glossary.gloss: trance induced by stopping all breathing

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sarve ’py ete yajïa-vido yajïa-kñapita-kalmañäù yajïa-çiñöämåta-bhujo yänti brahma sanätanam
transliteration: sarve 'py ete yajia-vido yajia-knapita-kalmanau yajia-cinoamata-bhujo yanti brahma sanatanam
translation: All these performers who know the meaning of sacrifice become cleansed of sinful reaction, and, having tasted the nectar of the remnants of such sacrifice, they go to the supreme eternal atmosphere.

glossary.gloss: conversant with the purpose of performing
being cleansed of the result of such performances
as a result of such performances of yajïa
those who have tasted such nectar

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: näyaà loko ’sty ayajïasya kuto ’nyaù kuru-sattama
transliteration: nayaa loko 'sty ayajiasya kuto 'nyau kuru-sattama
translation: O best of the Kuru dynasty, without sacrifice one can never live happily on this planet or in this life: what then of the next?
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: evaà bahu-vidhä yajïä vitatä brahmaëo mukhe karma-jän viddhi tän sarvän evaà jïätvä vimokñyase
transliteration: evaa bahu-vidha yajia vitata brahmaeo mukhe karma-jan viddhi tan sarvan evaa jiatva vimoknyase
translation: All these different types of sacrifice are approved by the Vedas, and all of them are born of different types of work. Knowing them as such, you will become liberated.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çreyän dravya-mayäd yajïäj jïäna-yajïaù parantapa sarvaà karmäkhilaà pärtha jïäne parisamäpyate
transliteration: creyan dravya-mayad yajiaj jiana-yajiau parantapa sarvaa karmakhilaa partha jiane parisamapyate
translation: O chastiser of the enemy, the sacrifice of knowledge is greater than the sacrifice of material possessions. O son of Påthä, after all, the sacrifice of work culminates in transcendental knowledge.

glossary.gloss: than the sacrifice of material possessions

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: tad viddhi praëipätena paripraçnena sevayä upadekñyanti te jïänaà jïäninas tattva-darçinaù
transliteration: tad viddhi praeipatena paripracnena sevaya upadeknyanti te jianaa jianinas tattva-darcinau
translation: Just try to learn the truth by approaching a spiritual master. Inquire from him submissively and render service unto him. The self-realized soul can impart knowledge unto you because he has seen the truth.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yaj jïätvä na punar moham evaà yäsyasi päëòava yena bhütäny açeñäëi drakñyasy ätmany atho mayi
transliteration: yaj jiatva na punar moham evaa yasyasi paeoava yena bhutany acenaei draknyasy atmany atho mayi
translation: And when you have thus learned the truth, you will know that all living beings are but part of Me—and that they are in Me, and are Mine.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: api ced asi päpebhyaù sarvebhyaù päpa-kåt-tamaù sarvaà jïäna-plavenaiva våjinaà santariñyasi
transliteration: api ced asi papebhyau sarvebhyau papa-kat-tamau sarvaa jiana-plavenaiva vajinaa santarinyasi
translation: Even if you are considered to be the most sinful of all sinners, when you are situated in the boat of transcendental knowledge, you will be able to cross over the ocean of miseries.

glossary.gloss: by the boat of transcendental knowledge

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yathaidhäàsi samiddho ’gnir bhasma-sät kurute ’rjuna jïänägniù sarva-karmäëi bhasma-sät kurute tathä
transliteration: yathaidhaasi samiddho 'gnir bhasma-sat kurute 'rjuna jianagniu sarva-karmaei bhasma-sat kurute tatha
translation: As the blazing fire turns firewood to ashes, O Arjuna, so does the fire of knowledge burn to ashes all reactions to material activities.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: na hi jïänena sadåçaà pavitram iha vidyate tat svayaà yoga-saàsiddhaù kälenätmani vindati
transliteration: na hi jianena sadacaa pavitram iha vidyate tat svayaa yoga-saasiddhau kalenatmani vindati
translation: In this world, there is nothing so sublime and pure as transcendental knowledge. Such knowledge is the mature fruit of all mysticism. And one who has achieved this enjoys the self within himself in due course of time.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çraddhäväl labhate jïänaà tat-paraù saàyatendriyaù jïänaà labdhvä paräà çäntim acireëädhigacchati
transliteration: craddhaval labhate jianaa tat-parau saayatendriyau jianaa labdhva paraa cantim acireeadhigacchati
translation: A faithful man who is absorbed in transcendental knowledge and who subdues his senses quickly attains the supreme spiritual peace.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ajïaç cäçraddadhänaç ca saàçayätmä vinaçyati näyaà loko ’sti na paro na sukhaà saàçayätmanaù
transliteration: ajiac cacraddadhanac ca saacayatma vinacyati nayaa loko 'sti na paro na sukhaa saacayatmanau
translation: But ignorant and faithless persons who doubt the revealed scriptures do not attain God consciousness. For the doubting soul there is happiness neither in this world nor in the next.

glossary.gloss: fools who have no knowledge in standard scriptures

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yoga-sannyasta-karmäëaà jïäna-saïchinna-saàçayam ätmavantaà na karmäëi nibadhnanti dhanaïjaya
transliteration: yoga-sannyasta-karmaeaa jiana-saichinna-saacayam atmavantaa na karmaei nibadhnanti dhanaijaya
translation: Therefore, one who has renounced the fruits of his action, whose doubts are destroyed by transcendental knowledge, and who is situated firmly in the self, is not bound by works, O conqueror of riches.

glossary.gloss: cut by the advancement of knowledge

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: tasmäd ajïäna-sambhütaà håt-sthaà jïänäsinätmanaù chittvainaà saàçayaà yogam ätiñöhottiñöha bhärata
transliteration: tasmad ajiana-sambhutaa hat-sthaa jianasinatmanau chittvainaa saacayaa yogam atinohottinoha bharata
translation: Therefore the doubts which have arisen in your heart out of ignorance should be slashed by the weapon of knowledge. Armed with yoga, O Bhärata, stand and fight.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: arjuna uväca sannyäsaà karmaëäà kåñëa punar yogaà ca çaàsasi yac chreya etayor ekaà tan me brühi su-niçcitam
transliteration: arjuna uvaca sannyasaa karmaeaa kanea punar yogaa ca caasasi yac chreya etayor ekaa tan me bruhi su-niccitam
translation: Arjuna said: O Kåñëa, first of all You ask me to renounce work, and then again You recommend work with devotion. Now will You kindly tell me definitely which of the two is more beneficial?
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çré-bhagavän uväca sannyäsaù karma-yogaç ca niùçreyasa-karäv ubhau tayos tu karma-sannyäsät karma-yogo viçiñyate
transliteration: cre-bhagavan uvaca sannyasau karma-yogac ca niucreyasa-karav ubhau tayos tu karma-sannyasat karma-yogo vicinyate
translation: The Blessed Lord said: The renunciation of work and work in devotion are both good for liberation. But, of the two, work in devotional service is better than renunciation of works.

glossary.gloss: all leading to the path of liberation
in comparison to the renunciation of fruitive work

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: jïeyaù sa nitya-sannyäsé yo na dveñöi na käìkñati nirdvandvo hi mahä-bäho sukhaà bandhät pramucyate
transliteration: jieyau sa nitya-sannyase yo na dvenoi na kaiknati nirdvandvo hi maha-baho sukhaa bandhat pramucyate
translation: One who neither hates nor desires the fruits of his activities is known to be always renounced. Such a person, liberated from all dualities, easily overcomes material bondage and is completely liberated, O mighty-armed Arjuna.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: säìkhya-yogau påthag bäläù pravadanti na paëòitäù ekam apy ästhitaù samyag ubhayor vindate phalam
transliteration: saikhya-yogau pathag balau pravadanti na paeoitau ekam apy asthitau samyag ubhayor vindate phalam
translation: Only the ignorant speak of karma-yoga and devotional service as being different from the analytical study of the material world [säìkhya]. Those who are actually learned say that he who applies himself well to one of these paths achieves the results of both.

glossary.gloss: analytical study of the material world

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yat säìkhyaiù präpyate sthänaà tad yogair api gamyate ekaà säìkhyaà ca yogaà ca yaù paçyati sa paçyati
transliteration: yat saikhyaiu prapyate sthanaa tad yogair api gamyate ekaa saikhyaa ca yogaa ca yau pacyati sa pacyati
translation: One who knows that the position reached by means of renunciation can also be attained by works in devotional service and who therefore sees that the path of works and the path of renunciation are one, sees things as they are.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sannyäsas tu mahä-bäho duùkham äptum ayogataù yoga-yukto munir brahma na cireëädhigacchati
transliteration: sannyasas tu maha-baho duukham aptum ayogatau yoga-yukto munir brahma na cireeadhigacchati
translation: Unless one is engaged in the devotional service of the Lord, mere renunciation of activities cannot make one happy. The sages, purified by works of devotion, achieve the Supreme without delay.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yoga-yukto viçuddhätmä vijitätmä jitendriyaù sarva-bhütätma-bhütätmä kurvann api na lipyate
transliteration: yoga-yukto vicuddhatma vijitatma jitendriyau sarva-bhutatma-bhutatma kurvann api na lipyate
translation: One who works in devotion, who is a pure soul, and who controls his mind and senses, is dear to everyone, and everyone is dear to him. Though always working, such a man is never entangled.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: naiva kiïcit karométi yukto manyeta tattva-vit paçyaï çåëvan spåçaï jighrann açnan gacchan svapan çvasan
transliteration: naiva kiicit karometi yukto manyeta tattva-vit pacyai caevan spacai jighrann acnan gacchan svapan cvasan
translation: A person in the divine consciousness, although engaged in seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, moving about, sleeping, and breathing, always knows within himself that he actually does nothing at all. Because while speaking, evacuating, receiving, opening or closing his eyes, he always knows that only the material senses are engaged with their objects and that he is aloof from them.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: pralapan visåjan gåhëann unmiñan nimiñann api indriyäëéndriyärtheñu vartanta iti dhärayan
transliteration: pralapan visajan gaheann unminan niminann api indriyaeendriyarthenu vartanta iti dharayan
translation: A person in the divine consciousness, although engaged in seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, moving about, sleeping, and breathing, always knows within himself that he actually does nothing at all. Because while speaking, evacuating, receiving, opening or closing his eyes, he always knows that only the material senses are engaged with their objects and that he is aloof from them.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: brahmaëy ädhäya karmäëi saìgaà tyaktvä karoti yaù lipyate na sa päpena padma-patram ivämbhasä
transliteration: brahmaey adhaya karmaei saigaa tyaktva karoti yau lipyate na sa papena padma-patram ivambhasa
translation: One who performs his duty without attachment, surrendering the results unto the Supreme God, is not affected by sinful action, as the lotus leaf is untouched by water.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: käyena manasä buddhyä kevalair indriyair api yoginaù karma kurvanti saìgaà tyaktvätma-çuddhaye
transliteration: kayena manasa buddhya kevalair indriyair api yoginau karma kurvanti saigaa tyaktvatma-cuddhaye
translation: The yogés, abandoning attachment, act with body, mind, intelligence, and even with the senses, only for the purpose of purification.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yuktaù karma-phalaà tyaktvä çäntim äpnoti naiñöhikém ayuktaù käma-käreëa phale sakto nibadhyate
transliteration: yuktau karma-phalaa tyaktva cantim apnoti nainohikem ayuktau kama-kareea phale sakto nibadhyate
translation: The steadily devoted soul attains unadulterated peace because he offers the result of all activities to Me; whereas a person who is not in union with the Divine, who is greedy for the fruits of his labor, becomes entangled.

glossary.gloss: one who is engaged in devotional service
one who is not in Kåñëa consciousness
for enjoying the result of work

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sarva-karmäëi manasä sannyasyäste sukhaà vaçé nava-dväre pure dehé naiva kurvan na kärayan
transliteration: sarva-karmaei manasa sannyasyaste sukhaa vace nava-dvare pure dehe naiva kurvan na karayan
translation: When the embodied living being controls his nature and mentally renounces all actions, he resides happily in the city of nine gates [the material body], neither working nor causing work to be done.

glossary.gloss: in the place where there are nine gates

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: na kartåtvaà na karmäëi lokasya såjati prabhuù na karma-phala-saàyogaà svabhävas tu pravartate
transliteration: na kartatvaa na karmaei lokasya sajati prabhuu na karma-phala-saayogaa svabhavas tu pravartate
translation: The embodied spirit, master of the city of his body, does not create activities, nor does he induce people to act, nor does he create the fruits of action. All this is enacted by the modes of material nature.

glossary.gloss: the master of the city of the body

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: nädatte kasyacit päpaà na caiva sukåtaà vibhuù ajïänenävåtaà jïänaà tena muhyanti jantavaù
transliteration: nadatte kasyacit papaa na caiva sukataa vibhuu ajianenavataa jianaa tena muhyanti jantavau
translation: Nor does the Supreme Spirit assume anyone’s sinful or pious activities. Embodied beings, however, are bewildered because of the ignorance which covers their real knowledge.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: jïänena tu tad ajïänaà yeñäà näçitam ätmanaù teñäm äditya-vaj jïänaà prakäçayati tat param
transliteration: jianena tu tad ajianaa yenaa nacitam atmanau tenam aditya-vaj jianaa prakacayati tat param
translation: When, however, one is enlightened with the knowledge by which nescience is destroyed, then his knowledge reveals everything, as the sun lights up everything in the daytime.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: tad-buddhayas tad-ätmänas tan-niñöhäs tat-paräyaëäù gacchanty apunar-ävåttià jïäna-nirdhüta-kalmañäù
transliteration: tad-buddhayas tad-atmanas tan-ninohas tat-parayaeau gacchanty apunar-avattia jiana-nirdhuta-kalmanau
translation: When one’s intelligence, mind, faith and refuge are all fixed in the Supreme, then one becomes fully cleansed of misgivings through complete knowledge and thus proceeds straight on the path of liberation.

glossary.gloss: one whose intelligence is always in the Supreme
one whose mind is always in the Supreme
whose mind is only meant for the Supreme
who has completely taken shelter of Him

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: vidyä-vinaya-sampanne brähmaëe gavi hastini çuni caiva çva-päke ca paëòitäù sama-darçinaù
transliteration: vidya-vinaya-sampanne brahmaee gavi hastini cuni caiva cva-pake ca paeoitau sama-darcinau
translation: The humble sage, by virtue of true knowledge, sees with equal vision a learned and gentle brähmaëa, a cow, an elephant, a dog and a dog-eater [outcaste] .
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ihaiva tair jitaù sargo yeñäà sämye sthitaà manaù nirdoñaà hi samaà brahma tasmäd brahmaëi te sthitäù
transliteration: ihaiva tair jitau sargo yenaa samye sthitaa manau nirdonaa hi samaa brahma tasmad brahmaei te sthitau
translation: Those whose minds are established in sameness and equanimity have already conquered the conditions of birth and death. They are flawless like Brahman, and thus they are already situated in Brahman.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: na prahåñyet priyaà präpya nodvijet präpya cäpriyam sthira-buddhir asammüòho brahma-vid brahmaëi sthitaù
transliteration: na prahanyet priyaa prapya nodvijet prapya capriyam sthira-buddhir asammuoho brahma-vid brahmaei sthitau
translation: A person who neither rejoices upon achieving something pleasant nor laments upon obtaining something unpleasant, who is self-intelligent, unbewildered, and who knows the science of God, is to be understood as already situated in Transcendence.

glossary.gloss: one who knows the Supreme perfectly

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: bähya-sparçeñv asaktätmä vindaty ätmani yat sukham sa brahma-yoga-yuktätmä sukham akñayam açnute
transliteration: bahya-sparcenv asaktatma vindaty atmani yat sukham sa brahma-yoga-yuktatma sukham aknayam acnute
translation: Such a liberated person is not attracted to material sense pleasure or external objects but is always in trance, enjoying the pleasure within. In this way the self-realized person enjoys unlimited happiness, for he concentrates on the Supreme.

glossary.gloss: one who is not so attached

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ye hi saàsparça-jä bhogä duùkha-yonaya eva te ädy-antavantaù kaunteya na teñu ramate budhaù
transliteration: ye hi saasparca-ja bhoga duukha-yonaya eva te ady-antavantau kaunteya na tenu ramate budhau
translation: An intelligent person does not take part in the sources of misery, which are due to contact with the material senses. O son of Kunté, such pleasures have a beginning and an end, and so the wise man does not delight in them.

glossary.gloss: by contact with the material senses

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çaknotéhaiva yaù soòhuà präk çaréra-vimokñaëät käma-krodhodbhavaà vegaà sa yuktaù sa sukhé naraù
transliteration: caknotehaiva yau soohua prak carera-vimoknaeat kama-krodhodbhavaa vegaa sa yuktau sa sukhe narau
translation: Before giving up this present body, if one is able to tolerate the urges of the material senses and check the force of desire and anger, he is a yogé and is happy in this world.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yo ’ntaù-sukho ’ntar-ärämas tathäntar-jyotir eva yaù sa yogé brahma-nirväëaà brahma-bhüto ’dhigacchati
transliteration: yo 'ntau-sukho 'ntar-aramas tathantar-jyotir eva yau sa yoge brahma-nirvaeaa brahma-bhuto 'dhigacchati
translation: One whose happiness is within, who is active within, who rejoices within and is illumined within, is actually the perfect mystic. He is liberated in the Supreme, and ultimately he attains the Supreme.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: labhante brahma-nirväëam åñayaù kñéëa-kalmañäù chinna-dvaidhä yatätmänaù sarva-bhüta-hite ratäù
transliteration: labhante brahma-nirvaeam anayau kneea-kalmanau chinna-dvaidha yatatmanau sarva-bhuta-hite ratau
translation: One who is beyond duality and doubt, whose mind is engaged within, who is always busy working for the welfare of all sentient beings, and who is free from all sins, achieves liberation in the Supreme.

glossary.gloss: who are devoid of all sins

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: käma-krodha-vimuktänäà yaténäà yata-cetasäm abhito brahma-nirväëaà vartate viditätmanäm
transliteration: kama-krodha-vimuktanaa yatenaa yata-cetasam abhito brahma-nirvaeaa vartate viditatmanam
translation: Those who are free from anger and all material desires, who are selfrealized, self-disciplined and constantly endeavoring for perfection, are assured of liberation in the Supreme in the very near future.

glossary.gloss: of those who are so liberated
of persons who have full control over the mind

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sparçän kåtvä bahir bähyäàç cakñuç caiväntare bhruvoù präëäpänau samau kåtvä näsäbhyantara-cäriëau
transliteration: sparcan katva bahir bahyaac caknuc caivantare bhruvou praeapanau samau katva nasabhyantara-carieau
translation: Shutting out all external sense objects, keeping the eyes and vision concentrated between the two eyebrows, suspending the inward and outward breaths within the nostrils—thus controlling the mind, senses and intelligence, the tranecendentalist becomes free from desire, fear and anger. One who is always in this state is certainly liberated.

glossary.gloss: external sense objects, such as sound, etc.

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yatendriya-mano-buddhir munir mokña-paräyaëaù vigatecchä-bhaya-krodho yaù sadä mukta eva saù
transliteration: yatendriya-mano-buddhir munir mokna-parayaeau vigateccha-bhaya-krodho yau sada mukta eva sau
translation: Shutting out all external sense objects, keeping the eyes and vision concentrated between the two eyebrows, suspending the inward and outward breaths within the nostrils—thus controlling the mind, senses and intelligence, the tranecendentalist becomes free from desire, fear and anger. One who is always in this state is certainly liberated.

glossary.gloss: external sense objects, such as sound, etc.

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: bhoktäraà yajïa-tapasäà sarva-loka-maheçvaram suhådaà sarva-bhütänäà jïätvä mäà çäntim åcchati
transliteration: bhoktaraa yajia-tapasaa sarva-loka-mahecvaram suhadaa sarva-bhutanaa jiatva maa cantim acchati
translation: The sages, knowing Me as the ultimate purpose of all sacrifices and austerities, the Supreme Lord of all planets and demigods and the benefactor and wellwisher of all living entities, attain peace from the pangs of material miseries.

glossary.gloss: all planets and the demigods thereof

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çré-bhagavän uväca anäçritaù karma-phalaà käryaà karma karoti yaù sa sannyäsé ca yogé ca na niragnir na cäkriyaù
transliteration: cre-bhagavan uvaca anacritau karma-phalaa karyaa karma karoti yau sa sannyase ca yoge ca na niragnir na cakriyau
translation: The Blessed Lord said: One who is unattached to the fruits of his work and who works as he is obligated is in the renounced order of life, and he is the true mystic: not he who lights no fire and performs no work.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yaà sannyäsam iti prähur yogaà taà viddhi päëòava na hy asannyasta-saìkalpo yogé bhavati kaçcana
transliteration: yaa sannyasam iti prahur yogaa taa viddhi paeoava na hy asannyasta-saikalpo yoge bhavati kaccana
translation: What is called renunciation is the same as yoga, or linking oneself with the Supreme, for no one can become a yogé unless he renounces the desire for sense gratification.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ärurukñor muner yogaà karma käraëam ucyate yogärüòhasya tasyaiva çamaù käraëam ucyate
transliteration: aruruknor muner yogaa karma karaeam ucyate yogaruohasya tasyaiva camau karaeam ucyate
translation: For one who is a neophyte in the eightfold yoga system, work is said to be the means; and for one who has already attained to yoga, cessation of all material activities is said to be the means.

glossary.gloss: of one who has just begun yoga

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yadä hi nendriyärtheñu na karmasv anuñajjate sarva-saìkalpa-sannyäsé yogärüòhas tadocyate
transliteration: yada hi nendriyarthenu na karmasv anunajjate sarva-saikalpa-sannyase yogaruohas tadocyate
translation: A person is said to have attained to yoga when, having renounced all material desires, he neither acts for sense gratification nor engages in fruitive activities.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: uddhared ätmanätmänaà nätmänam avasädayet ätmaiva hy ätmano bandhur ätmaiva ripur ätmanaù
transliteration: uddhared atmanatmanaa natmanam avasadayet atmaiva hy atmano bandhur atmaiva ripur atmanau
translation: A man must elevate himself by his own mind, not degrade himself. The mind is the friend of the conditioned soul, and his enemy as well.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: bandhur ätmätmanas tasya yenätmaivätmanä jitaù anätmanas tu çatrutve vartetätmaiva çatru-vat
transliteration: bandhur atmatmanas tasya yenatmaivatmana jitau anatmanas tu catrutve vartetatmaiva catru-vat
translation: For him who has conquered the mind, the mind is the best of friends; but for one who has failed to do so, his very mind will be the greatest enemy.

glossary.gloss: of one who has failed to control the mind

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: jitätmanaù praçäntasya paramätmä samähitaù çétoñëa-sukha-duùkheñu tathä mänäpamänayoù
transliteration: jitatmanau pracantasya paramatma samahitau cetonea-sukha-duukhenu tatha manapamanayou
translation: For one who has conquered the mind, the Supersoul is already reached, for he has attained tranquility. To such a man happiness and distress, heat and cold, honor and dishonor are all the same.

glossary.gloss: of one who has conquered his mind
of one who has attained tranquility by such control over the mind

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: jïäna-vijïäna-tåptätmä küöa-stho vijitendriyaù yukta ity ucyate yogé sama-loñöräçma-käïcanaù
transliteration: jiana-vijiana-taptatma kuoa-stho vijitendriyau yukta ity ucyate yoge sama-lonoracma-kaicanau
translation: A person is said to be established in self-realization and is called a yogé [or mystic] when he is fully satisfied by virtue of acquired knowledge and realization. Such a person is situated in transcendence and is self-controlled. He sees everything—whether it be pebbles, stones or gold—as the same.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: suhån-miträry-udäsénamadhyastha-dveñya-bandhuñu sädhuñv api ca päpeñu sama-buddhir viçiñyate
transliteration: suhan-mitrary-udasenamadhyastha-dvenya-bandhunu sadhunv api ca papenu sama-buddhir vicinyate
translation: A person is said to be still further advanced when he regards all—the honest well-wisher, friends and enemies, the envious, the pious, the sinner and those who are indifferent and impartial—with an equal mind.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yogé yuïjéta satatam ätmänaà rahasi sthitaù ekäké yata-cittätmä niräçér aparigrahaù
transliteration: yoge yuijeta satatam atmanaa rahasi sthitau ekake yata-cittatma niracer aparigrahau
translation: A transcendentalist should always try to concentrate his mind on the Supreme Self; he should live alone in a secluded place and should always carefully control his mind. He should be free from desires and feelings of possessiveness.

glossary.gloss: himself (by the body, mind and self)
without being attracted by anything else
free from the feeling of possessiveness.

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çucau deçe pratiñöhäpya sthiram äsanam ätmanaù näty-ucchritaà näti-nécaà cailäjina-kuçottaram
transliteration: cucau dece pratinohapya sthiram asanam atmanau naty-ucchritaa nati-necaa cailajina-kucottaram
translation: To practice yoga, one should go to a secluded place and should lay kuça-grass on the ground and then cover it with a deerskin and a soft cloth. The seat should neither be too high nor too low and should be situated in a sacred place. The yogé should then sit on it very firmly and should practice yoga by controlling the mind and the senses, purifying the heart and fixing the mind on one point.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: tatraikägraà manaù kåtvä yata-cittendriya-kriyaù upaviçyäsane yuïjyäd yogam ätma-viçuddhaye
transliteration: tatraikagraa manau katva yata-cittendriya-kriyau upavicyasane yuijyad yogam atma-vicuddhaye
translation: To practice yoga, one should go to a secluded place and should lay kuça-grass on the ground and then cover it with a deerskin and a soft cloth. The seat should neither be too high nor too low and should be situated in a sacred place. The yogé should then sit on it very firmly and should practice yoga by controlling the mind and the senses, purifying the heart and fixing the mind on one point.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: samaà käya-çiro-grévaà dhärayann acalaà sthiraù samprekñya näsikägraà svaà diçaç cänavalokayan
transliteration: samaa kaya-ciro-grevaa dharayann acalaa sthirau sampreknya nasikagraa svaa dicac canavalokayan
translation: One should hold one’s body, neck and head erect in a straight line and stare steadily at the tip of the nose. Thus with an unagitated, subdued mind, devoid of fear, completely free from sex life, one should meditate upon Me within the heart and make Me the ultimate goal of life.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: praçäntätmä vigata-bhér brahmacäri-vrate sthitaù manaù saàyamya mac-citto yukta äséta mat-paraù
transliteration: pracantatma vigata-bher brahmacari-vrate sthitau manau saayamya mac-citto yukta aseta mat-parau
translation: One should hold one’s body, neck and head erect in a straight line and stare steadily at the tip of the nose. Thus with an unagitated, subdued mind, devoid of fear, completely free from sex life, one should meditate upon Me within the heart and make Me the ultimate goal of life.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yuïjann evaà sadätmänaà yogé niyata-mänasaù çäntià nirväëa-paramäà mat-saàsthäm adhigacchati
transliteration: yuijann evaa sadatmanaa yoge niyata-manasau cantia nirvaea-paramaa mat-saastham adhigacchati
translation: Thus practicing control of the body, mind and activities, the mystic transcendentalist attains to the kingdom of God [or the abode of Kåñëa] by cessation of material existence.

glossary.gloss: in the spiritual sky (the kingdom of God)

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: näty-açnatas ’tu yogo ’sti na caikäntam anaçnataù na cäti-svapna-çélasya jägrato naiva cärjuna
transliteration: naty-acnatas 'tu yogo 'sti na caikantam anacnatau na cati-svapna-celasya jagrato naiva carjuna
translation: There is no possibility of one’s becoming a yogé, O Arjuna, if one eats too much, or eats too little, sleeps too much or does not sleep enough.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yuktähära-vihärasya yukta-ceñöasya karmasu yukta-svapnävabodhasya yogo bhavati duùkha-hä
transliteration: yuktahara-viharasya yukta-cenoasya karmasu yukta-svapnavabodhasya yogo bhavati duukha-ha
translation: He who is temperate in his habits of eating, sleeping, working and recreation can mitigate all material pains by practicing the yoga system.

glossary.gloss: of one who works for maintenance

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yadä viniyataà cittam ätmany evävatiñöhate nispåhaù sarva-kämebhyo yukta ity ucyate tadä
transliteration: yada viniyataa cittam atmany evavatinohate nispahau sarva-kamebhyo yukta ity ucyate tada
translation: When the yogé, by practice of yoga, disciplines his mental activities and becomes situated in Transcendence—devoid of all material desires—he is said to have attained yoga.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yathä dépo niväta-stho neìgate sopamä småtä yogino yata-cittasya yuïjato yogam ätmanaù
transliteration: yatha depo nivata-stho neigate sopama smata yogino yata-cittasya yuijato yogam atmanau
translation: As a lamp in a windless place does not waver, so the transcendentalist, whose mind is controlled, remains always steady in his meditation on the transcendent Self.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yatroparamate cittaà niruddhaà yoga-sevayä yatra caivätmanätmänaà paçyann ätmani tuñyati
transliteration: yatroparamate cittaa niruddhaa yoga-sevaya yatra caivatmanatmanaa pacyann atmani tunyati
translation: The stage of perfection is called trance, or samädhi, when one’s mind is completely restrained from material mental activities by practice of yoga. This is characterized by one’s ability to see the self by the pure mind and to relish and rejoice in the self. In that joyous state, one is situated in boundless transcendental happiness and enjoys himself through transcendental senses. Established thus, one never departs from the truth, and upon gaining this he thinks there is no greater gain. Being situated in such a position, one is never shaken, even in the midst of greatest difficulty. This indeed is actual freedom from all miseries arising from material contact.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sukham ätyantikaà yat tad buddhi-grähyam aténdriyam vetti yatra na caiväyaà
transliteration: sukham atyantikaa yat tad buddhi-grahyam atendriyam vetti yatra na caivayaa
translation: The stage of perfection is called trance, or samädhi, when one’s mind is completely restrained from material mental activities by practice of yoga. This is characterized by one’s ability to see the self by the pure mind and to relish and rejoice in the self. In that joyous state, one is situated in boundless transcendental happiness and enjoys himself through transcendental senses. Established thus, one never departs from the truth, and upon gaining this he thinks there is no greater gain. Being situated in such a position, one is never shaken, even in the midst of greatest difficulty. This indeed is actual freedom from all miseries arising from material contact.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sthitaç calati tattvataù yaà labdhvä cäparaà läbhaà manyate nädhikaà tataù
transliteration: sthitac calati tattvatau yaa labdhva caparaa labhaa manyate nadhikaa tatau
translation: The stage of perfection is called trance, or samädhi, when one’s mind is completely restrained from material mental activities by practice of yoga. This is characterized by one’s ability to see the self by the pure mind and to relish and rejoice in the self. In that joyous state, one is situated in boundless transcendental happiness and enjoys himself through transcendental senses. Established thus, one never departs from the truth, and upon gaining this he thinks there is no greater gain. Being situated in such a position, one is never shaken, even in the midst of greatest difficulty. This indeed is actual freedom from all miseries arising from material contact.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yasmin sthito na duùkhena guruëäpi vicälyate taà vidyäd duùkha-saàyogaviyogaà yoga-saàjïitam
transliteration: yasmin sthito na duukhena gurueapi vicalyate taa vidyad duukha-saayogaviyogaa yoga-saajiitam
translation: The stage of perfection is called trance, or samädhi, when one’s mind is completely restrained from material mental activities by practice of yoga. This is characterized by one’s ability to see the self by the pure mind and to relish and rejoice in the self. In that joyous state, one is situated in boundless transcendental happiness and enjoys himself through transcendental senses. Established thus, one never departs from the truth, and upon gaining this he thinks there is no greater gain. Being situated in such a position, one is never shaken, even in the midst of greatest difficulty. This indeed is actual freedom from all miseries arising from material contact.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sa niçcayena yoktavyo yogo ’nirviëëa-cetasä saìkalpa-prabhavän kämäàs tyaktvä sarvän açeñataù manasaivendriya-grämaà viniyamya samantataù
transliteration: sa niccayena yoktavyo yogo 'nirvieea-cetasa saikalpa-prabhavan kamaas tyaktva sarvan acenatau manasaivendriya-gramaa viniyamya samantatau
translation: One should engage oneself in the practice of yoga with undeviating determination and faith. One should abandon, without exception, all material desires born of false ego and thus control all the senses on all sides by the mind.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çanaiù çanair uparamed buddhyä dhåti-gåhétayä ätma-saàsthaà manaù kåtvä na kiïcid api cintayet
transliteration: canaiu canair uparamed buddhya dhati-gahetaya atma-saasthaa manau katva na kiicid api cintayet
translation: Gradually, step by step, with full conviction, one should become situated in trance by means of intelligence, and thus the mind should be fixed on the Self alone and should think of nothing else.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yato yato niçcalati manaç caïcalam asthiram tatas tato niyamyaitad ätmany eva vaçaà nayet
transliteration: yato yato niccalati manac caicalam asthiram tatas tato niyamyaitad atmany eva vacaa nayet
translation: From whatever and wherever the mind wanders due to its flickering and unsteady nature, one must certainly withdraw it and bring it back under the control of the Self.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: praçänta-manasaà hy enaà yoginaà sukham uttamam upaiti çänta-rajasaà brahma-bhütam akalmañam
transliteration: pracanta-manasaa hy enaa yoginaa sukham uttamam upaiti canta-rajasaa brahma-bhutam akalmanam
translation: The yogé whose mind is fixed on Me verily attains the highest happiness. By virtue of his identity with Brahman, he is liberated; his mind is peaceful, his passions are quieted, and he is freed from sin.

glossary.gloss: mind fixed on the lotus feet of Kåñëa
of one whose mind is so fixed
liberated by identification with the Absolute
freed from all past sinful reaction.

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yuïjann evaà sadätmänaà yogé vigata-kalmañaù sukhena brahma-saàsparçam atyantaà sukham açnute
transliteration: yuijann evaa sadatmanaa yoge vigata-kalmanau sukhena brahma-saasparcam atyantaa sukham acnute
translation: Steady in the Self, being freed from all material contamination, the yogé achieves the highest perfectional stage of happiness in touch with the Supreme Consciousness.

glossary.gloss: thus being engaged in yoga practice
one who is in touch with the Supreme Self
being in constant touch with the Supreme

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sarva-bhüta-stham ätmänaà sarva-bhütäni cätmani ékñate yoga-yuktätmä sarvatra sama-darçanaù
transliteration: sarva-bhuta-stham atmanaa sarva-bhutani catmani eknate yoga-yuktatma sarvatra sama-darcanau
translation: A true yogé observes Me in all beings, and also sees every being in Me. Indeed, the self-realized man sees Me everywhere.

glossary.gloss: one who is dovetailed in Kåñëa consciousness

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yo mäà paçyati sarvatra sarvaà ca mayi paçyati tasyähaà na praëaçyämi sa ca me na praëaçyati
transliteration: yo maa pacyati sarvatra sarvaa ca mayi pacyati tasyahaa na praeacyami sa ca me na praeacyati
translation: For one who sees Me everywhere and sees everything in Me, I am never lost, nor is he ever lost to Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sarva-bhüta-sthitaà yo mäà bhajaty ekatvam ästhitaù sarvathä vartamäno ’pi sa yogé mayi vartate
transliteration: sarva-bhuta-sthitaa yo maa bhajaty ekatvam asthitau sarvatha vartamano 'pi sa yoge mayi vartate
translation: The yogé who knows that I and the Supersoul within all creatures are one worships Me and remains always in Me in all circumstances.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ätmaupamyena sarvatra samaà paçyati yo ’rjuna sukhaà vä yadi vä duùkhaà sa yogé paramo mataù
transliteration: atmaupamyena sarvatra samaa pacyati yo 'rjuna sukhaa va yadi va duukhaa sa yoge paramo matau
translation: He is a perfect yogé who, by comparison to his own self, sees the true equality of all beings, both in their happiness and distress, O Arjuna!
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: arjuna uväca yo ’yaà yogas tvayä proktaù sämyena madhusüdana etasyähaà na paçyämi caïcalatvät sthitià sthiräm
transliteration: arjuna uvaca yo 'yaa yogas tvaya proktau samyena madhusudana etasyahaa na pacyami caicalatvat sthitia sthiram
translation: Arjuna said: O Madhusüdana, the system of yoga which you have summarized appears impractical and unendurable to me, for the mind is restless and unsteady.

glossary.gloss: O killer of the demon Madhu

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: caïcalaà hi manaù kåñëa pramäthi balavad dåòham tasyähaà nigrahaà manye väyor iva su-duñkaram
transliteration: caicalaa hi manau kanea pramathi balavad daoham tasyahaa nigrahaa manye vayor iva su-dunkaram
translation: For the mind is restless, turbulent, obstinate and very strong, O Kåñëa, and to subdue it is, it seems to me, more difficult than controlling the wind.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çré-bhagavän uväca asaàçayaà mahä-bäho mano durnigrahaà calam abhyäsena tu kaunteya vairägyeëa ca gåhyate
transliteration: cre-bhagavan uvaca asaacayaa maha-baho mano durnigrahaa calam abhyasena tu kaunteya vairagyeea ca gahyate
translation: The Blessed Lord said: O mighty-armed son of Kunté, it is undoubtedly very difficult to curb the restless mind, but it is possible by constant practice and by detachment.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: asaàyatätmanä yogo duñpräpa iti me matiù vaçyätmanä tu yatatä çakyo ’väptum upäyataù
transliteration: asaayatatmana yogo dunprapa iti me matiu vacyatmana tu yatata cakyo 'vaptum upayatau
translation: For one whose mind is unbridled, self-realization is difficult work. But he whose mind is controlled and who strives by right means is assured of success. That is My opinion.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: arjuna uväca ayatiù çraddhayopeto yogäc calita-mänasaù apräpya yoga-saàsiddhià käà gatià kåñëa gacchati
transliteration: arjuna uvaca ayatiu craddhayopeto yogac calita-manasau aprapya yoga-saasiddhia kaa gatia kanea gacchati
translation: Arjuna said: What is the destination of the man of faith who does not persevere, who in the beginning takes to the process of self-realization but who later desists due to worldly-mindedness and thus does not attain perfection in mysticism?

glossary.gloss: of one who has such a mind

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: kaccin nobhaya-vibhrañöaç chinnäbhram iva naçyati apratiñöho mahä-bäho vimüòho brahmaëaù pathi
transliteration: kaccin nobhaya-vibhranoac chinnabhram iva nacyati apratinoho maha-baho vimuoho brahmaeau pathi
translation: O mighty-armed Kåñëa, does not such a man, being deviated from the path of Transcendence, perish like a riven cloud, with no position in any sphere?
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: etan me saàçayaà kåñëa chettum arhasy açeñataù tvad-anyaù saàçayasyäsya chettä na hy upapadyate
transliteration: etan me saacayaa kanea chettum arhasy acenatau tvad-anyau saacayasyasya chetta na hy upapadyate
translation: This is my doubt O Kåñëa, and I ask You to dispel it completely. But for Yourself, no one is to be found who can destroy this doubt.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çré-bhagavän uväca pärtha naiveha nämutra vinäças tasya vidyate na hi kalyäëa-kåt kaçcid durgatià täta gacchati
transliteration: cre-bhagavan uvaca partha naiveha namutra vinacas tasya vidyate na hi kalyaea-kat kaccid durgatia tata gacchati
translation: The Blessed Lord said: Son of Påthä, a transcendentalist engaged in auspicious activities does not meet with destruction either in this world or in the spiritual world; one who does good, My friend, is never overcome by evil.

glossary.gloss: the Supreme Personality of Godhead said
one who is engaged in auspicious activities

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: präpya puëya-kåtäà lokän uñitvä çäçvatéù samäù çucénäà çrématäà gehe yoga-bhrañöo ’bhijäyate
transliteration: prapya pueya-kataa lokan unitva cacvateu samau cucenaa cremataa gehe yoga-bhranoo 'bhijayate
translation: The unsuccessful yogé, after many, many years of enjoyment on the planets of the pious living entities, is born into a family of righteous people, or into a family of rich aristocracy.

glossary.gloss: of those who performed pious activities
one who is fallen from the path of self-realization

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: atha vä yoginäm eva kule bhavati dhématäm etad dhi durlabhataraà loke janma yad édåçam
transliteration: atha va yoginam eva kule bhavati dhematam etad dhi durlabhataraa loke janma yad edacam
translation: Or he takes his birth in a family of transcendentalists who are surely great in wisdom. Verily, such a birth is rare in this world.

glossary.gloss: of those who are endowed with great wisdom

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: tatra taà buddhi-saàyogaà labhate paurva-dehikam yatate ca tato bhüyaù saàsiddhau kuru-nandana
transliteration: tatra taa buddhi-saayogaa labhate paurva-dehikam yatate ca tato bhuyau saasiddhau kuru-nandana
translation: On taking such a birth, he again revives the divine consciousness of his previous life, and he tries to make further progress in order to achieve complete success, O son of Kuru.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: pürväbhyäsena tenaiva hriyate hy avaço ’pi saù jijïäsur api yogasya çabda-brahmätivartate
transliteration: purvabhyasena tenaiva hriyate hy avaco 'pi sau jijiasur api yogasya cabda-brahmativartate
translation: By virtue of the divine consciousness of his previous life, he automatically becomes attracted to the yogic principles—even without seeking them. Such an inquisitive transcendentalist, striving for yoga, stands always above the ritualistic principles of the scriptures.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: prayatnäd yatamänas tu yogé saàçuddha-kilbiñaù aneka-janma-saàsiddhas tato yäti paräà gatim
transliteration: prayatnad yatamanas tu yoge saacuddha-kilbinau aneka-janma-saasiddhas tato yati paraa gatim
translation: But when the yogé engages himself with sincere endeavor in making further progress, being washed of all contaminations, then ultimately, after many, many births of practice, he attains the supreme goal.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: tapasvibhyo ’dhiko yogé jïänibhyo ’pi mato ’dhikaù karmibhyaç cädhiko yogé tasmäd yogé bhavärjuna
transliteration: tapasvibhyo 'dhiko yoge jianibhyo 'pi mato 'dhikau karmibhyac cadhiko yoge tasmad yoge bhavarjuna
translation: A yogé is greater than the ascetic, greater than the empiricist and greater than the fruitive worker. Therefore, O Arjuna, in all circumstances, be a yogé.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yoginäm api sarveñäà mad-gatenäntar-ätmanä çraddhävän bhajate yo mäà sa me yuktatamo mataù
transliteration: yoginam api sarvenaa mad-gatenantar-atmana craddhavan bhajate yo maa sa me yuktatamo matau
translation: And of all yogés, he who always abides in Me with great faith, worshiping Me in transcendental loving service, is most intimately united with Me in yoga and is the highest of all.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çré-bhagavän uväca mayy äsakta-manäù pärtha yogaà yuïjan mad-äçrayaù asaàçayaà samagraà mäà yathä jïäsyasi tac chåëu
transliteration: cre-bhagavan uvaca mayy asakta-manau partha yogaa yuijan mad-acrayau asaacayaa samagraa maa yatha jiasyasi tac chaeu
translation: Now hear, O son of Påthä [Arjuna], how by practicing yoga in full consciousness of Me, with mind attached to Me, you can know Me in full, free from doubt.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: jïänaà te ’haà sa-vijïänam idaà vakñyämy açeñataù yaj jïätvä neha bhüyo ’nyaj jïätavyam avaçiñyate
transliteration: jianaa te 'haa sa-vijianam idaa vaknyamy acenatau yaj jiatva neha bhuyo 'nyaj jiatavyam avacinyate
translation: I shall now declare unto you in full this knowledge both phenomenal and noumenal, by knowing which there shall remain nothing further to be known.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: manuñyäëäà sahasreñu kaçcid yatati siddhaye yatatäm api siddhänäà kaçcin mäà vetti tattvataù
transliteration: manunyaeaa sahasrenu kaccid yatati siddhaye yatatam api siddhanaa kaccin maa vetti tattvatau
translation: Out of many thousands among men, one may endeavor for perfection, and of those who have achieved perfection, hardly one knows Me in truth.

glossary.gloss: of those who have achieved perfection

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: bhümir äpo ’nalo väyuù khaà mano buddhir eva ca ahaìkära itéyaà me bhinnä prakåtir añöadhä
transliteration: bhumir apo 'nalo vayuu khaa mano buddhir eva ca ahaikara iteyaa me bhinna prakatir anoadha
translation: Earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intelligence and false ego—altogether these eight comprise My separated material energies.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: apareyam itas tv anyäà prakåtià viddhi me paräm jéva-bhütäà mahä-bäho yayedaà dhäryate jagat
transliteration: apareyam itas tv anyaa prakatia viddhi me param jeva-bhutaa maha-baho yayedaa dharyate jagat
translation: Besides this inferior nature, O mighty-armed Arjuna, there is a superior energy of Mine, which are all living entities who are struggling with material nature and are sustaining the universe.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: etad-yonéni bhütäni sarväëéty upadhäraya ahaà kåtsnasya jagataù prabhavaù pralayas tathä
transliteration: etad-yoneni bhutani sarvaeety upadharaya ahaa katsnasya jagatau prabhavau pralayas tatha
translation: Of all that is material and all that is spiritual in this world, know for certain that I am both its origin and dissolution.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: mattaù parataraà nänyat kiïcid asti dhanaïjaya mayi sarvam idaà protaà sütre maëi-gaëä iva
transliteration: mattau parataraa nanyat kiicid asti dhanaijaya mayi sarvam idaa protaa sutre maei-gaea iva
translation: O conquerer of wealth [Arjuna], there is no Truth superior to Me. Everything rests upon Me, as pearls are strung on a thread.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: raso ’ham apsu kaunteya prabhäsmi çaçi-süryayoù praëavaù sarva-vedeñu çabdaù khe pauruñaà nåñu
transliteration: raso 'ham apsu kaunteya prabhasmi caci-suryayou praeavau sarva-vedenu cabdau khe paurunaa nanu
translation: O son of Kunté [Arjuna], I am the taste of water, the light of the sun and the moon, the syllable om in the Vedic mantras; I am the sound in ether and ability in man.

glossary.gloss: in the sun and the moon

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: puëyo gandhaù påthivyäà ca tejaç cäsmi vibhävasau jévanaà sarva-bhüteñu tapaç cäsmi tapasviñu
transliteration: pueyo gandhau pathivyaa ca tejac casmi vibhavasau jevanaa sarva-bhutenu tapac casmi tapasvinu
translation: I am the original fragrance of the earth, and I am the heat in fire. I am the life of all that lives, and I am the penances of all ascetics.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: béjaà mäà sarva-bhütänäà viddhi pärtha sanätanam buddhir buddhimatäm asmi tejas tejasvinäm aham
transliteration: bejaa maa sarva-bhutanaa viddhi partha sanatanam buddhir buddhimatam asmi tejas tejasvinam aham
translation: O son of Påthä, know that I am the original seed of all existences, the intelligence of the intelligent, and the prowess of all powerful men.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: balaà balavatäà cähaà käma-räga-vivarjitam dharmäviruddho bhüteñu kämo ’smi bharatarñabha
transliteration: balaa balavataa cahaa kama-raga-vivarjitam dharmaviruddho bhutenu kamo 'smi bharatarnabha
translation: I am the strength of the strong, devoid of passion and desire. I am sex life which is not contrary to religious principles, O Lord of the Bhäratas [Arjuna].
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ye caiva sättvikä bhävä räjasäs tämasäç ca ye matta eveti tän viddhi na tv ahaà teñu te mayi
transliteration: ye caiva sattvika bhava rajasas tamasac ca ye matta eveti tan viddhi na tv ahaa tenu te mayi
translation: All states of being—be they of goodness, passion or ignorance—are manifested by My energy. I am, in one sense, everything—but I am independant. I am not under the modes of this material nature.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: tribhir guëa-mayair bhävair ebhiù sarvam idaà jagat mohitaà näbhijänäti mäm ebhyaù param avyayam
transliteration: tribhir guea-mayair bhavair ebhiu sarvam idaa jagat mohitaa nabhijanati mam ebhyau param avyayam
translation: Deluded by the three modes [goodness, passion and ignorance], the whole world does not know Me who am above the modes and inexhaustible.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: daivé hy eñä guëa-mayé mama mäyä duratyayä mäm eva ye prapadyante mäyäm etäà taranti te
transliteration: daive hy ena guea-maye mama maya duratyaya mam eva ye prapadyante mayam etaa taranti te
translation: This divine energy of Mine, consisting of the three modes of material nature, is difficult to overcome. But those who have surrendered unto Me can easily cross beyond it.

glossary.gloss: consisting of the three modes of material nature

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: na mäà duñkåtino müòhäù prapadyante narädhamäù mäyayäpahåta-jïänä äsuraà bhävam äçritäù
transliteration: na maa dunkatino muohau prapadyante naradhamau mayayapahata-jiana asuraa bhavam acritau
translation: Those miscreants who are grossly foolish, lowest among mankind, whose knowledge is stolen by illusion, and who partake of the atheistic nature of demons, do not surrender unto Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: catur-vidhä bhajante mäà janäù sukåtino ’rjuna ärto jijïäsur arthärthé jïäné ca bharatarñabha
transliteration: catur-vidha bhajante maa janau sukatino 'rjuna arto jijiasur artharthe jiane ca bharatarnabha
translation: O best among the Bhäratas [Arjuna], four kinds of pious men render devotional service unto Me—the distressed, the desirer of wealth, the inquisitive, and he who is searching for knowledge of the Absolute.

glossary.gloss: one who knows things as they are
O great one amongst the descendants of Bharata.

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: teñäà jïäné nitya-yukta eka-bhaktir viçiñyate priyo hi jïänino ’tyartham ahaà sa ca mama priyaù
transliteration: tenaa jiane nitya-yukta eka-bhaktir vicinyate priyo hi jianino 'tyartham ahaa sa ca mama priyau
translation: Of these, the wise one who is in full knowledge in union with Me through pure devotional service is the best. For I am very dear to him, and he is dear to Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: udäräù sarva evaite jïäné tv ätmaiva me matam ästhitaù sa hi yuktätmä mäm evänuttamäà gatim
transliteration: udarau sarva evaite jiane tv atmaiva me matam asthitau sa hi yuktatma mam evanuttamaa gatim
translation: All these devotees are undoubtedly magnanimous souls, but he who is situated in knowledge of Me I consider verily to dwell in Me. Being engaged in My transcendental service, he attains Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: bahünäà janmanäm ante jïänavän mäà prapadyate väsudevaù sarvam iti sa mahätmä su-durlabhaù
transliteration: bahunaa janmanam ante jianavan maa prapadyate vasudevau sarvam iti sa mahatma su-durlabhau
translation: After many births and deaths, he who is actually in knowledge surrenders unto Me, knowing Me to be the cause of all causes and all that is. Such a great soul is very rare.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: kämais tais tair håta-jïänäù prapadyante ’nya-devatäù taà taà niyamam ästhäya prakåtyä niyatäù svayä
transliteration: kamais tais tair hata-jianau prapadyante 'nya-devatau taa taa niyamam asthaya prakatya niyatau svaya
translation: Those whose minds are distorted by material desires surrender unto demigods and follow the particular rules and regulations of worship according to their own natures.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yo yo yäà yäà tanuà bhaktaù çraddhayärcitum icchati tasya tasyäcaläà çraddhäà täm eva vidadhämy aham
transliteration: yo yo yaa yaa tanua bhaktau craddhayarcitum icchati tasya tasyacalaa craddhaa tam eva vidadhamy aham
translation: I am in everyone’s heart as the Supersoul. As soon as one desires to worship the demigods, I make his faith steady so that he can devote himself to some particular deity.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sa tayä çraddhayä yuktas tasyärädhanam éhate labhate ca tataù kämän mayaiva vihitän hi tän
transliteration: sa taya craddhaya yuktas tasyaradhanam ehate labhate ca tatau kaman mayaiva vihitan hi tan
translation: Endowed with such a faith, he seeks favors of a particular demigod and obtains his desires. But in actuality these benefits are bestowed by Me alone.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: antavat tu phalaà teñäà tad bhavaty alpa-medhasäm devän deva-yajo yänti mad-bhaktä yänti mäm api
transliteration: antavat tu phalaa tenaa tad bhavaty alpa-medhasam devan deva-yajo yanti mad-bhakta yanti mam api
translation: Men of small intelligence worship the demigods, and their fruits are limited and temporary. Those who worship the demigods go to the planets of the demigods, but My devotees ultimately reach My supreme planet.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: avyaktaà vyaktim äpannaà manyante mäm abuddhayaù paraà bhävam ajänanto mamävyayam anuttamam
transliteration: avyaktaa vyaktim apannaa manyante mam abuddhayau paraa bhavam ajananto mamavyayam anuttamam
translation: Unintelligent men, who know Me not, think that I have assumed this form and personality. Due to their small knowledge, they do not know My higher nature, which is changeless and supreme.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: nähaà prakäçaù sarvasya yoga-mäyä-samävåtaù müòho ’yaà näbhijänäti loko mäm ajam avyayam
transliteration: nahaa prakacau sarvasya yoga-maya-samavatau muoho 'yaa nabhijanati loko mam ajam avyayam
translation: I am never manifest to the foolish and unintelligent. For them I am covered by My eternal creative potency [yoga-mäyä]; and so the deluded world knows Me not, who am unborn and infallible.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: vedähaà samatétäni vartamänäni cärjuna bhaviñyäëi ca bhütäni mäà tu veda na kaçcana
transliteration: vedahaa samatetani vartamanani carjuna bhavinyaei ca bhutani maa tu veda na kaccana
translation: O Arjuna, as the Supreme Personality of Godhead, I know everything that has happened in the past, all that is happening in the present, and all things that are yet to come. I also know all living entities; but Me no one knows.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: icchä-dveña-samutthena dvandva-mohena bhärata sarva-bhütäni sammohaà sarge yänti parantapa
transliteration: iccha-dvena-samutthena dvandva-mohena bharata sarva-bhutani sammohaa sarge yanti parantapa
translation: O scion of Bharata [Arjuna], O conquerer of the foe, all living entities are born into delusion, overcome by the dualities of desire and hate.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yeñäà tv anta-gataà päpaà janänäà puëya-karmaëäm te dvandva-moha-nirmuktä bhajante mäà dåòha-vratäù
transliteration: yenaa tv anta-gataa papaa jananaa pueya-karmaeam te dvandva-moha-nirmukta bhajante maa daoha-vratau
translation: Persons who have acted piously in previous lives and in this life, whose sinful actions are completely eradicated and who are freed from the duality of delusion, engage themselves in My service with determination.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: jarä-maraëa-mokñäya mäm äçritya yatanti ye te brahma tad viduù kåtsnam adhyätmaà karma cäkhilam
transliteration: jara-maraea-moknaya mam acritya yatanti ye te brahma tad viduu katsnam adhyatmaa karma cakhilam
translation: Intelligent persons who are endeavoring for liberation from old age and death take refuge in Me in devotional service. They are actually Brahman because they entirely know everything about transcendental and fruitive activities.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sädhibhütädhidaivaà mäà sädhiyajïaà ca ye viduù prayäëa-käle ’pi ca mäà te vidur yukta-cetasaù
transliteration: sadhibhutadhidaivaa maa sadhiyajiaa ca ye viduu prayaea-kale 'pi ca maa te vidur yukta-cetasau
translation: Those who know Me as the Supreme Lord, as the governing principle of the material manifestation, who know Me as the one underlying all the demigods and as the one sustaining all sacrifices, can, with steadfast mind, understand and know Me even at the time of death.

glossary.gloss: the governing principle of the material manifestation

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: arjuna uväca kià tad brahma kim adhyätmaà kià karma puruñottama adhibhütaà ca kià proktam adhidaivaà kim ucyate
transliteration: arjuna uvaca kia tad brahma kim adhyatmaa kia karma purunottama adhibhutaa ca kia proktam adhidaivaa kim ucyate
translation: Arjuna inquired: O my Lord, O Supreme Person, what is Brahman? What is the self? What are fruitive activities? What is this material manifestation? And what are the demigods? Please explain this to me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: adhiyajïaù kathaà ko ’tra dehe ’smin madhusüdana prayäëa-käle ca kathaà jïeyo ’si niyatätmabhiù
transliteration: adhiyajiau kathaa ko 'tra dehe 'smin madhusudana prayaea-kale ca kathaa jieyo 'si niyatatmabhiu
translation: How does this Lord of sacrifice live in the body, and in which part does He live, O Madhusüdana? And how can those engaged in devotional service know You at the time of death?
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çré-bhagavän uväca akñaraà brahma paramaà svabhävo ’dhyätmam ucyate bhüta-bhävodbhava-karo visargaù karma-saàjïitaù
transliteration: cre-bhagavan uvaca aknaraa brahma paramaa svabhavo 'dhyatmam ucyate bhuta-bhavodbhava-karo visargau karma-saajiitau
translation: The Supreme Lord said, The indestructible, transcendental living entity is called Brahman, and his eternal nature is called the self. Action pertaining to the development of these material bodies is called karma, or fruitive activities.

glossary.gloss: the Supreme Personality of Godhead said
action producing the material bodies of the living entities

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: adhibhütaà kñaro bhävaù puruñaç cädhidaivatam adhiyajïo ’ham evätra dehe deha-bhåtäà vara
transliteration: adhibhutaa knaro bhavau purunac cadhidaivatam adhiyajio 'ham evatra dehe deha-bhataa vara
translation: Physical nature is known to be endlessly mutable. The universe is the cosmic form of the Supreme Lord, and I am that Lord represented as the Supersoul, dwelling in the heart of every embodied being.

glossary.gloss: including all demigods like the sun and moon

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: anta-käle ca mäm eva smaran muktvä kalevaram yaù prayäti sa mad-bhävaà yäti nästy atra saàçayaù
transliteration: anta-kale ca mam eva smaran muktva kalevaram yau prayati sa mad-bhavaa yati nasty atra saacayau
translation: And whoever, at the time of death, quits his body, remembering Me alone, at once attains My nature. Of this there is no doubt.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yaà yaà väpi smaran bhävaà tyajaty ante kalevaram taà tam evaiti kaunteya sadä tad-bhäva-bhävitaù
transliteration: yaa yaa vapi smaran bhavaa tyajaty ante kalevaram taa tam evaiti kaunteya sada tad-bhava-bhavitau
translation: Whatever state of being one remembers when he quits his body, that state he will attain without fail.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: tasmät sarveñu käleñu mäm anusmara yudhya ca mayy arpita-mano-buddhir mäm evaiñyasy asaàçayaù
transliteration: tasmat sarvenu kalenu mam anusmara yudhya ca mayy arpita-mano-buddhir mam evainyasy asaacayau
translation: Therefore, Arjuna, you should always think of Me in the form of Kåñëa and at the same time carry out your prescribed duty of fighting. With your activities dedicated to Me and your mind and intelligence fixed on Me, you will attain Me without doubt.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: abhyäsa-yoga-yuktena cetasä nänya-gäminä paramaà puruñaà divyaà yäti pärthänucintayan
transliteration: abhyasa-yoga-yuktena cetasa nanya-gamina paramaa purunaa divyaa yati parthanucintayan
translation: He who meditates on the Supreme Personality of Godhead, his mind constantly engaged in remembering Me, undeviated from the path, he, O Pärtha [Arjuna], is sure to reach Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: kavià puräëam anuçäsitäram aëor aëéyäàsam anusmared yaù sarvasya dhätäram acintya-rüpam äditya-varëaà tamasaù parastät
transliteration: kavia puraeam anucasitaram aeor aeeyaasam anusmared yau sarvasya dhataram acintya-rupam aditya-vareaa tamasau parastat
translation: One should meditate upon the Supreme Person as the one who knows everything, as He who is the oldest, who is the controller, who is smaller than the smallest, who is the maintainer of everything, who is beyond all material conception, who is inconceivable, and who is always a person. He is luminous like the sun and, being transcendental, is beyond this material nature.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: prayäëa-käle manasäcalena bhaktyä yukto yoga-balena caiva bhruvor madhye präëam äveçya samyak sa taà paraà puruñam upaiti divyam
transliteration: prayaea-kale manasacalena bhaktya yukto yoga-balena caiva bhruvor madhye praeam avecya samyak sa taa paraa purunam upaiti divyam
translation: One who, at the time of death, fixes his life air between the eyebrows and in full devotion engages himself in remembering the Supreme Lord, will certainly attain to the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

glossary.gloss: by the power of mystic yoga

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text
