iast: yad akñaraà veda-vido vadanti viçanti yad yatayo véta-rägäù yad icchanto brahmacaryaà caranti tat te padaà saìgraheëa pravakñye
transliteration: yad aknaraa veda-vido vadanti vicanti yad yatayo veta-ragau yad icchanto brahmacaryaa caranti tat te padaa saigraheea pravaknye
translation: Persons learned in the Vedas, who utter omkära and who are great sages in the renounced order, enter into Brahman. Desiring such perfection, one practices celibacy. I shall now explain to you this process by which one may attain salvation.

glossary.gloss: a person conversant with the Vedas
in the renounced order of life

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sarva-dväräëi saàyamya mano hådi nirudhya ca mürdhny ädhäyätmanaù präëam ästhito yoga-dhäraëäm
transliteration: sarva-dvaraei saayamya mano hadi nirudhya ca murdhny adhayatmanau praeam asthito yoga-dharaeam
translation: The yogic situation is that of detachment from all sensual engagements. Closing all the doors of the senses and fixing the mind on the heart and the life air at the top of the head, one establishes himself in yoga.

glossary.gloss: all the doors of the body

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: oà ity ekäkñaraà brahma vyäharan mäm anusmaran yaù prayäti tyajan dehaà sa yäti paramäà gatim
transliteration: oa ity ekaknaraa brahma vyaharan mam anusmaran yau prayati tyajan dehaa sa yati paramaa gatim
translation: After being situated in this yoga practice and vibrating the sacred syllable om, the supreme combination of letters, if one thinke of the Supreme Personality of Godhead and quits his body, he will certainly reach the spiritual planets.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ananya-cetäù satataà yo mäà smarati nityaçaù tasyähaà sulabhaù pärtha nitya-yuktasya yoginaù
transliteration: ananya-cetau satataa yo maa smarati nityacau tasyahaa sulabhau partha nitya-yuktasya yoginau
translation: For one who remembers Me without deviation, I am easy to obtain, O son of Påthä, because of his constant engagement in devotional service.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: mäm upetya punar janma duùkhälayam açäçvatam näpnuvanti mahätmänaù saàsiddhià paramäà gatäù
transliteration: mam upetya punar janma duukhalayam acacvatam napnuvanti mahatmanau saasiddhia paramaa gatau
translation: After attaining Me, the great souls, who are yogés in devotion, never return to this temporary world, which is full of miseries, because they have attained the highest perfection.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ä-brahma-bhuvanäl lokäù punar ävartino ’rjuna mäm upetya tu kaunteya punar janma na vidyate
transliteration: a-brahma-bhuvanal lokau punar avartino 'rjuna mam upetya tu kaunteya punar janma na vidyate
translation: From the highest planet in the material world down to the lowest, all are places of misery wherein repeated birth and death take place. But one who attains to My abode, O son of Kunté, never takes birth again.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sahasra-yuga-paryantam ahar yad brahmaëo viduù rätrià yuga-sahasräntäà te ’ho-rätra-vido janäù
transliteration: sahasra-yuga-paryantam ahar yad brahmaeo viduu ratria yuga-sahasrantaa te 'ho-ratra-vido janau
translation: By human calculation, a thousand ages taken together is the duration of Brahmä’s one day. And such also is the duration of his night.

glossary.gloss: similarly, at the end of one thousand

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: avyaktäd vyaktayaù sarväù prabhavanty ahar-ägame rätry-ägame praléyante tatraivävyakta-saàjïake
transliteration: avyaktad vyaktayau sarvau prabhavanty ahar-agame ratry-agame praleyante tatraivavyakta-saajiake
translation: When Brahmä’s day is manifest, this multitude of living entities comes into being, and at the arrival of Brahmä’s night they are all annihilated.

glossary.gloss: at the beginning of the day

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: bhüta-grämaù sa eväyaà bhütvä bhütvä praléyate rätry-ägame ’vaçaù pärtha prabhavaty ahar-ägame
transliteration: bhuta-gramau sa evayaa bhutva bhutva praleyate ratry-agame 'vacau partha prabhavaty ahar-agame
translation: Again and again the day comes, and this host of beings is active; and again the night falls, O Pärtha, and they are helplessly dissolved.

glossary.gloss: the aggregate of all living entities

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: paras tasmät tu bhävo ’nyo ’vyakto ’vyaktät sanätanaù yaù sa sarveñu bhüteñu naçyatsu na vinaçyati
transliteration: paras tasmat tu bhavo 'nyo 'vyakto 'vyaktat sanatanau yau sa sarvenu bhutenu nacyatsu na vinacyati
translation: Yet there is another nature, which is eternal and is transcendental to this manifested and unmanifested matter. It is supreme and is never annihilated. When all in this world is annihilated, that part remains as it is.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: avyakto ’kñara ity uktas tam ähuù paramäà gatim yaà präpya na nivartante tad dhäma paramaà mama
transliteration: avyakto 'knara ity uktas tam ahuu paramaa gatim yaa prapya na nivartante tad dhama paramaa mama
translation: That supreme abode is called unmanifested and infallible, and it is the supreme destination. When one goes there, he never comes back. That is My supreme abode.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: puruñaù sa paraù pärtha bhaktyä labhyas tv ananyayä yasyäntaù-sthäni bhütäni yena sarvam idaà tatam
transliteration: purunau sa parau partha bhaktya labhyas tv ananyaya yasyantau-sthani bhutani yena sarvam idaa tatam
translation: The Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is greater than all, is attainable by unalloyed devotion. Although He is present in His abode, He is all-pervading, and everything is situated within Him.

glossary.gloss: the Supreme, than whom no one is greater

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yatra käle tv anävåttim ävåttià caiva yoginaù prayätä yänti taà kälaà vakñyämi bharatarñabha
transliteration: yatra kale tv anavattim avattia caiva yoginau prayata yanti taa kalaa vaknyami bharatarnabha
translation: O best of the Bhäratas, I shall now explain to you the different times at which, passing away from this world, one does or does not come back.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: agnir jyotir ahaù çuklaù ñaë-mäsä uttaräyaëam tatra prayätä gacchanti brahma brahma-vido janäù
transliteration: agnir jyotir ahau cuklau nae-masa uttarayaeam tatra prayata gacchanti brahma brahma-vido janau
translation: Those who know the Supreme Brahman pass away from the world during the influence of the fiery god, in the light, at an auspicious moment, during the fortnight of the moon and the six months when the sun travels in the north.

glossary.gloss: when the sun passes on the northern side

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: dhümo rätris tathä kåñëaù ñaë-mäsä dakñiëäyanam tatra cändramasaà jyotir yogé präpya nivartate
transliteration: dhumo ratris tatha kaneau nae-masa daknieayanam tatra candramasaa jyotir yoge prapya nivartate
translation: The mystic who passes away from this world during the smoke, the night, the moonlight fortnight, or in the six months when the sun passes to the south, or who reaches the moon planet, again comes back.

glossary.gloss: the fortnight of the dark moon
when the sun passes on the southern side

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çukla-kåñëe gaté hy ete jagataù çäçvate mate ekayä yäty anävåttim anyayävartate punaù
transliteration: cukla-kanee gate hy ete jagatau cacvate mate ekaya yaty anavattim anyayavartate punau
translation: According to the Vedas, there are two ways of passing from this world—one in light and one in darkness. When one passes in light, he does not come back; but when one passes in darkness, he returns.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: naite såté pärtha jänan yogé muhyati kaçcana tasmät sarveñu käleñu yoga-yukto bhavärjuna
transliteration: naite sate partha janan yoge muhyati kaccana tasmat sarvenu kalenu yoga-yukto bhavarjuna
translation: The devotees who know these two paths, O Arjuna, are never bewildered. Therefore be always fixed in devotion.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: vedeñu yajïeñu tapaùsu caiva däneñu yat puëya-phalaà pradiñöam atyeti tat sarvam idaà viditvä yogé paraà sthänam upaiti cädyam
transliteration: vedenu yajienu tapausu caiva danenu yat pueya-phalaa pradinoam atyeti tat sarvam idaa viditva yoge paraa sthanam upaiti cadyam
translation: A person who accepts the path of devotional service is not bereft of the results derived from studying the Vedas, performing austere sacrifices, giving charity or pursuing philosophical and fruitive activities. At the end he reaches the supreme abode.

glossary.gloss: in the study of the Vedas
in the performances of yajïa, sacrifice

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çré-bhagavän uväca idaà tu te guhyatamaà pravakñyämy anasüyave jïänaà vijïäna-sahitaà yaj jïätvä mokñyase ’çubhät
transliteration: cre-bhagavan uvaca idaa tu te guhyatamaa pravaknyamy anasuyave jianaa vijiana-sahitaa yaj jiatva moknyase 'cubhat
translation: The Supreme Lord said: My dear Arjuna, because you are never envious of Me, I shall impart to you this most secret wisdom, knowing which you shall be relieved of the miseries of material existence.

glossary.gloss: the Supreme Personality of Godhead said

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: räja-vidyä räja-guhyaà pavitram idam uttamam pratyakñävagamaà dharmyaà su-sukhaà kartum avyayam
transliteration: raja-vidya raja-guhyaa pavitram idam uttamam pratyaknavagamaa dharmyaa su-sukhaa kartum avyayam
translation: This knowledge is the king of education, the most secret of all secrets. It is the purest knowledge, and because it gives direct perception of the self by realization, it is the perfection of religion. It is everlasting, and it is joyfully performed.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: açraddadhänäù puruñä dharmasyäsya parantapa apräpya mäà nivartante måtyu-saàsära-vartmani
transliteration: acraddadhanau puruna dharmasyasya parantapa aprapya maa nivartante matyu-saasara-vartmani
translation: Those who are not faithful on the path of devotional service cannot attain Me, O conqueror of foes, but return to birth and death in this material world.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: mayä tatam idaà sarvaà jagad avyakta-mürtinä mat-sthäni sarva-bhütäni na cähaà teñv avasthitaù
transliteration: maya tatam idaa sarvaa jagad avyakta-murtina mat-sthani sarva-bhutani na cahaa tenv avasthitau
translation: By Me, in My unmanifested form, this entire universe is pervaded. All beings are in Me, but I am not in them.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: na ca mat-sthäni bhütäni paçya me yogam aiçvaram bhüta-bhån na ca bhüta-stho mamätmä bhüta-bhävanaù
transliteration: na ca mat-sthani bhutani pacya me yogam aicvaram bhuta-bhan na ca bhuta-stho mamatma bhuta-bhavanau
translation: And yet everything that is created does not rest in Me. Behold My mystic opulence! Although I am the maintainer of all living entities, and although I am everywhere, still My Self is the very source of creation.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yathäkäça-sthito nityaà väyuù sarvatra-go mahän tathä sarväëi bhütäni mat-sthänéty upadhäraya
transliteration: yathakaca-sthito nityaa vayuu sarvatra-go mahan tatha sarvaei bhutani mat-sthanety upadharaya
translation: As the mighty wind, blowing everywhere, always rests in ethereal space know that in the same manner all beings rest in Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sarva-bhütäni kaunteya prakåtià yänti mämikäm kalpa-kñaye punas täni kalpädau visåjämy aham
transliteration: sarva-bhutani kaunteya prakatia yanti mamikam kalpa-knaye punas tani kalpadau visajamy aham
translation: O son of Kunté, at the end of the millennium every material manifestation enters into My nature, and at the beginning of another millennium, by My potency I again create.

glossary.gloss: at the end of the millennium
in the beginning of the millennium

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: prakåtià sväm avañöabhya visåjämi punaù punaù bhüta-grämam imaà kåtsnam avaçaà prakåter vaçät
transliteration: prakatia svam avanoabhya visajami punau punau bhuta-gramam imaa katsnam avacaa prakater vacat
translation: The whole cosmic order is under Me. By My will it is manifested again and again, and by My will it is annihilated at the end.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: na ca mäà täni karmäëi nibadhnanti dhanaïjaya udäséna-vad äsénam asaktaà teñu karmasu
transliteration: na ca maa tani karmaei nibadhnanti dhanaijaya udasena-vad asenam asaktaa tenu karmasu
translation: O Dhanaïjaya, all this work cannot bind Me. I am ever detached, seated as though neutral.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: mayädhyakñeëa prakåtiù süyate sa-caräcaram hetunänena kaunteya jagad viparivartate
transliteration: mayadhyakneea prakatiu suyate sa-caracaram hetunanena kaunteya jagad viparivartate
translation: This material nature is working under My direction, O son of Kunté, and it is producing all moving and unmoving beings. By its rule this manifestation is created and annihilated again and again.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: avajänanti mäà müòhä mänuñéà tanum äçritam paraà bhävam ajänanto mama bhüta-maheçvaram
transliteration: avajananti maa muoha manunea tanum acritam paraa bhavam ajananto mama bhuta-mahecvaram
translation: Fools deride Me when I descend in the human form. They do not know My transcendental nature and My supreme dominion over all that be.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: moghäçä mogha-karmäëo mogha-jïänä vicetasaù räkñasém äsuréà caiva prakåtià mohinéà çritäù
transliteration: moghaca mogha-karmaeo mogha-jiana vicetasau raknasem asurea caiva prakatia mohinea critau
translation: Those who are thus bewildered are attracted by demonic and atheistic views. In that deluded condition, their hopes for liberation, their fruitive activities, and their culture of knowledge are all defeated.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: mahätmänas tu mäà pärtha daivéà prakåtim äçritäù bhajanty ananya-manaso jïätvä bhütädim avyayam
transliteration: mahatmanas tu maa partha daivea prakatim acritau bhajanty ananya-manaso jiatva bhutadim avyayam
translation: O son of Påthä, those who are not deluded, the great souls, are under the protection of the divine nature. They are fully engaged in devotional service because they know Me as the Supreme Personality of Godhead, original and inexhaustible.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: satataà kértayanto mäà yatantaç ca dåòha-vratäù namasyantaç ca mäà bhaktyä nitya-yuktä upäsate
transliteration: satataa kertayanto maa yatantac ca daoha-vratau namasyantac ca maa bhaktya nitya-yukta upasate
translation: Always chanting My glories, endeavoring with great determination, bowing down before Me, these great souls perpetually worship Me with devotion.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: jïäna-yajïena cäpy anye yajanto mäm upäsate ekatvena påthaktvena bahudhä viçvato-mukham
transliteration: jiana-yajiena capy anye yajanto mam upasate ekatvena pathaktvena bahudha vicvato-mukham
translation: Others, who are engaged in the cultivation of knowledge, worship the Supreme Lord as the one without a second, diverse in many, and in the universal form.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ahaà kratur ahaà yajïaù svadhäham aham auñadham mantro ’ham aham eväjyam aham agnir ahaà hutam
transliteration: ahaa kratur ahaa yajiau svadhaham aham aunadham mantro 'ham aham evajyam aham agnir ahaa hutam
translation: But it is I who am the ritual, I the sacrifice, the offering to the ancestors, the healing herb, the transcendental chant. I am the butter and the fire and the offering.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: pitäham asya jagato mätä dhätä pitämahaù vedyaà pavitram oàkära åk säma yajur eva ca
transliteration: pitaham asya jagato mata dhata pitamahau vedyaa pavitram oakara ak sama yajur eva ca
translation: I am the father of this universe, the mother, the support, and the grandsire. I am the object of knowledge, the purifier and the syllable om. I am also the Åk, the Säma, and the Yajur [Vedas].
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: gatir bhartä prabhuù säkñé niväsaù çaraëaà suhåt prabhavaù pralayaù sthänaà nidhänaà béjam avyayam
transliteration: gatir bharta prabhuu sakne nivasau caraeaa suhat prabhavau pralayau sthanaa nidhanaa bejam avyayam
translation: I am the goal, the sustainer, the master, the witness, the abode, the refuge and the most dear friend. I am the creation and the annihilation, the basis of everything, the resting place and the eternal seed.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: tapämy aham ahaà varñaà nigåhëämy utsåjämi ca amåtaà caiva måtyuç ca sad asac cäham arjuna
transliteration: tapamy aham ahaa varnaa nigaheamy utsajami ca amataa caiva matyuc ca sad asac caham arjuna
translation: O Arjuna, I control heat, the rain and the drought. I am immortality, and I am also death personified. Both being and nonbeing are in Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: trai-vidyä mäà soma-päù püta-päpä yajïair iñövä svar-gatià prärthayante te puëyam äsädya surendra-lokam açnanti divyän divi deva-bhogän
transliteration: trai-vidya maa soma-pau puta-papa yajiair inova svar-gatia prarthayante te pueyam asadya surendra-lokam acnanti divyan divi deva-bhogan
translation: Those who study the Vedas and drink the soma juice, seeking the heavenly planets, worship Me indirectly. They take birth on the planet of Indra, where they enjoy godly delights.

glossary.gloss: the knowers of the three Vedas

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: te taà bhuktvä svarga-lokaà viçälaà kñéëe puëye martya-lokaà viçanti evaà trayé-dharmam anuprapannä gatägataà käma-kämä labhante
transliteration: te taa bhuktva svarga-lokaa vicalaa kneee pueye martya-lokaa vicanti evaa traye-dharmam anuprapanna gatagataa kama-kama labhante
translation: When they have thus enjoyed heavenly sense pleasure, they return to this mortal planet again. Thus, through the Vedic principles, they achieve only flickering happiness.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ananyäç cintayanto mäà ye janäù paryupäsate teñäà nityäbhiyuktänäà yoga-kñemaà vahämy aham
transliteration: ananyac cintayanto maa ye janau paryupasate tenaa nityabhiyuktanaa yoga-knemaa vahamy aham
translation: But those who worship Me with devotion, meditating on My transcendental form—to them I carry what they lack and preserve what they have.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ye ’py anya-devatä-bhaktä yajante çraddhayänvitäù te ’pi mäm eva kaunteya yajanty avidhi-pürvakam
transliteration: ye 'py anya-devata-bhakta yajante craddhayanvitau te 'pi mam eva kaunteya yajanty avidhi-purvakam
translation: Whatever a man may sacrifice to other gods, O son of Kunté, is really meant for Me alone, but it is offered without true understanding.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ahaà hi sarva-yajïänäà bhoktä ca prabhur eva ca na tu mäm abhijänanti tattvenätaç cyavanti te
transliteration: ahaa hi sarva-yajianaa bhokta ca prabhur eva ca na tu mam abhijananti tattvenatac cyavanti te
translation: I am the only enjoyer and the only object of sacrifice. Those who do not recognize My true transcendental nature fall down.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yänti deva-vratä devän pitèn yänti pitå-vratäù bhütäni yänti bhütejyä yänti mad-yäjino ’pi mäm
transliteration: yanti deva-vrata devan piten yanti pita-vratau bhutani yanti bhutejya yanti mad-yajino 'pi mam
translation: Those who worship the demigods will take birth among the demigods; those who worship ghosts and spirits will take birth among such beings; those who worship ancestors go to the ancestors; and those who worship Me will live with Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: patraà puñpaà phalaà toyaà yo me bhaktyä prayacchati tad ahaà bhakty-upahåtam açnämi prayatätmanaù
transliteration: patraa punpaa phalaa toyaa yo me bhaktya prayacchati tad ahaa bhakty-upahatam acnami prayatatmanau
translation: If one offers Me with love and devotion a leaf, a flower, fruit a water, I will accept it.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yat karoñi yad açnäsi yaj juhoñi dadäsi yat yat tapasyasi kaunteya tat kuruñva mad-arpaëam
transliteration: yat karoni yad acnasi yaj juhoni dadasi yat yat tapasyasi kaunteya tat kurunva mad-arpaeam
translation: O son of Kunté, all that you do, all that you eat, all that you offer and give away, as well as all austerities that you may perform, should be done as an offering unto Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çubhäçubha-phalair evaà mokñyase karma-bandhanaiù sannyäsa-yoga-yuktätmä vimukto mäm upaiñyasi
transliteration: cubhacubha-phalair evaa moknyase karma-bandhanaiu sannyasa-yoga-yuktatma vimukto mam upainyasi
translation: In this way you will be freed from all reactions to good and evil deeds, and by this principle of renunciation you will be liberated and come to Me.

glossary.gloss: having the mind firmly set on

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: samo ’haà sarva-bhüteñu na me dveñyo ’sti na priyaù ye bhajanti tu mäà bhaktyä mayi te teñu cäpy aham
transliteration: samo 'haa sarva-bhutenu na me dvenyo 'sti na priyau ye bhajanti tu maa bhaktya mayi te tenu capy aham
translation: I envy no one, nor am I partial to anyone. I am equal to all. But whoever renders service unto Me in devotion is a friend, is in Me, and I am also a friend to him.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: api cet su-duräcäro bhajate mäm ananya-bhäk sädhur eva sa mantavyaù samyag vyavasito hi saù
transliteration: api cet su-duracaro bhajate mam ananya-bhak sadhur eva sa mantavyau samyag vyavasito hi sau
translation: Even if one commits the most abominable actions, if he is engaged in devotional service, he is to be considered saintly because he is properly situated.

glossary.gloss: one committing the most abominable actions

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: kñipraà bhavati dharmätmä çaçvac-chäntià nigacchati kaunteya pratijänéhi na me bhaktaù praëaçyati
transliteration: knipraa bhavati dharmatma cacvac-chantia nigacchati kaunteya pratijanehi na me bhaktau praeacyati
translation: He quickly becomes righteous and attains lasting peace. O son of Kunté, declare it boldly that My devotee never perishes.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: mäà hi pärtha vyapäçritya ye ’pi syuù päpa-yonayaù striyo vaiçyäs tathä çüdräs te ’pi yänti paräà gatim
transliteration: maa hi partha vyapacritya ye 'pi syuu papa-yonayau striyo vaicyas tatha cudras te 'pi yanti paraa gatim
translation: O son of Påthä, those who take shelter in Me, though they be of lower birth— women, vaiçyas [merchants], as well as çüdras [workers]—can approach the supreme destination.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: kià punar brähmaëäù puëyä bhaktä räjarñayas tathä anityam asukhaà lokam imaà präpya bhajasva mäm
transliteration: kia punar brahmaeau pueya bhakta rajarnayas tatha anityam asukhaa lokam imaa prapya bhajasva mam
translation: How much greater then are the brähmaëas, the righteous, the devotees and saintly kings who in this temporary miserable world engage in loving service unto Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: man-manä bhava mad-bhakto mad-yäjé mäà namaskuru mäm evaiñyasi yuktvaivam ätmänaà mat-paräyaëaù
transliteration: man-mana bhava mad-bhakto mad-yaje maa namaskuru mam evainyasi yuktvaivam atmanaa mat-parayaeau
translation: Engage your mind always in thinking of Me, offer obeisances and worship Me. Being completely absorbed in Me, surely you will come to Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çré-bhagavän uväca bhüya eva mahä-bäho çåëu me paramaà vacaù yat te ’haà préyamäëäya vakñyämi hita-kämyayä
transliteration: cre-bhagavan uvaca bhuya eva maha-baho caeu me paramaa vacau yat te 'haa preyamaeaya vaknyami hita-kamyaya
translation: The Supreme Lord said: My dear friend, mighty-armed Arjuna, listen again to My supreme word, which I shall impart to you for your benefit and which will give you great joy.

glossary.gloss: the Supreme Personality of Godhead said

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: na me viduù sura-gaëäù prabhavaà na maharñayaù aham ädir hi devänäà maharñéëäà ca sarvaçaù
transliteration: na me viduu sura-gaeau prabhavaa na maharnayau aham adir hi devanaa maharneeaa ca sarvacau
translation: Neither the hosts of demigods nor the great sages know My origin, for, in every respect, I am the source of the demigods and the sages.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yo mäm ajam anädià ca vetti loka-maheçvaram asammüòhaù sa martyeñu sarva-päpaiù pramucyate
transliteration: yo mam ajam anadia ca vetti loka-mahecvaram asammuohau sa martyenu sarva-papaiu pramucyate
translation: He who knows Me as the unborn, as the beginningless, as the Supreme Lord of all the worlds—he, undeluded among men, is freed from all sins.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: buddhir jïänam asammohaù kñamä satyaà damaù çamaù sukhaà duùkhaà bhavo ’bhävo bhayaà cäbhayam eva ca
transliteration: buddhir jianam asammohau knama satyaa damau camau sukhaa duukhaa bhavo 'bhavo bhayaa cabhayam eva ca
translation: Intelligence, knowledge, freedom from doubt and delusion, forgiveness, truthfulness, self-control and calmness, pleasure and pain, birth, death, fear, fearlessness, nonviolence, equanimity, satisfaction, austerity, charity, fame and infamy are created by Me alone.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ahiàsä samatä tuñöis tapo dänaà yaço ’yaçaù bhavanti bhävä bhütänäà matta eva påthag-vidhäù
transliteration: ahiasa samata tunois tapo danaa yaco 'yacau bhavanti bhava bhutanaa matta eva pathag-vidhau
translation: Intelligence, knowledge, freedom from doubt and delusion, forgiveness, truthfulness, self-control and calmness, pleasure and pain, birth, death, fear, fearlessness, nonviolence, equanimity, satisfaction, austerity, charity, fame and infamy are created by Me alone.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: maharñayaù sapta pürve catväro manavas tathä mad-bhävä mänasä jätä yeñäà loka imäù prajäù
transliteration: maharnayau sapta purve catvaro manavas tatha mad-bhava manasa jata yenaa loka imau prajau
translation: The seven great sages and before them the four other great sages and the Manus [progenitors of mankind] are born out of My mind, and all creatures in these planets descend from them.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: etäà vibhütià yogaà ca mama yo vetti tattvataù so ’vikalpena yogena yujyate nätra saàçayaù
transliteration: etaa vibhutia yogaa ca mama yo vetti tattvatau so 'vikalpena yogena yujyate natra saacayau
translation: He who knows in truth this glory and power of Mine engages in unalloyed devotional service; of this there is no doubt.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ahaà sarvasya prabhavo mattaù sarvaà pravartate iti matvä bhajante mäà budhä bhäva-samanvitäù
transliteration: ahaa sarvasya prabhavo mattau sarvaa pravartate iti matva bhajante maa budha bhava-samanvitau
translation: I am the source of all spiritual and material worlds. Everything emanates from Me. The wise who know this perfectly engage in My devotional service and worship Me with all their hearts.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: mac-cittä mad-gata-präëä bodhayantaù parasparam kathayantaç ca mäà nityaà tuñyanti ca ramanti ca
transliteration: mac-citta mad-gata-praea bodhayantau parasparam kathayantac ca maa nityaa tunyanti ca ramanti ca
translation: The thoughts of My pure devotees dwell in Me, their lives are surrendered to Me, and they derive great satisfaction and bliss enlightening one another and conversing about Me.

glossary.gloss: lives devoted to the service of Kåñëa

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: teñäà satata-yuktänäà bhajatäà préti-pürvakam dadämi buddhi-yogaà taà yena mäm upayänti te
transliteration: tenaa satata-yuktanaa bhajataa preti-purvakam dadami buddhi-yogaa taa yena mam upayanti te
translation: To those who are constantly devoted and worship Me with love, I give the understanding by which they can come to Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: teñäm evänukampärtham aham ajïäna-jaà tamaù näçayämy ätma-bhäva-stho jïäna-dépena bhäsvatä
transliteration: tenam evanukampartham aham ajiana-jaa tamau nacayamy atma-bhava-stho jiana-depena bhasvata
translation: Out of compassion for them, I, dwelling in their hearts, destroy with the shining lamp of knowledge the darkness born of ignorance.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: arjuna uväca paraà brahma paraà dhäma pavitraà paramaà bhavän puruñaà çäçvataà divyam ädi-devam ajaà vibhum
transliteration: arjuna uvaca paraa brahma paraa dhama pavitraa paramaa bhavan purunaa cacvataa divyam adi-devam ajaa vibhum
translation: Arjuna said: You are the Supreme Brahman, the ultimate, the supreme abode and purifier, the Absolute Truth and the eternal divine person. You are the primal God, transcendental and original, and You are the unborn and allpervading beauty. All the great sages such as Närada, Asita, Devala, and Vyäsa proclaim this of You, and now You Yourself are declaring it to me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ähus tväm åñayaù sarve devarñir näradas tathä asito devalo vyäsaù svayaà caiva bravéñi me
transliteration: ahus tvam anayau sarve devarnir naradas tatha asito devalo vyasau svayaa caiva braveni me
translation: Arjuna said: You are the Supreme Brahman, the ultimate, the supreme abode and purifier, the Absolute Truth and the eternal divine person. You are the primal God, transcendental and original, and You are the unborn and allpervading beauty. All the great sages such as Närada, Asita, Devala, and Vyäsa proclaim this of You, and now You Yourself are declaring it to me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sarvam etad åtaà manye yan mäà vadasi keçava na hi te bhagavan vyaktià vidur devä na dänaväù
transliteration: sarvam etad ataa manye yan maa vadasi kecava na hi te bhagavan vyaktia vidur deva na danavau
translation: O Kåñëa, I totally accept as truth all that You have told me. Neither the gods nor demons, O Lord, know Thy personality.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: svayam evätmanätmänaà vettha tvaà puruñottama bhüta-bhävana bhüteça deva-deva jagat-pate
transliteration: svayam evatmanatmanaa vettha tvaa purunottama bhuta-bhavana bhuteca deva-deva jagat-pate
translation: Indeed, You alone know Yourself by Your own potencies, O origin of all, Lord of all beings, God of gods, O Supreme Person, Lord of the universe!

glossary.gloss: O Lord of the entire universe.

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: vaktum arhasy açeñeëa divyä hy ätma-vibhütayaù yäbhir vibhütibhir lokän imäàs tvaà vyäpya tiñöhasi
transliteration: vaktum arhasy aceneea divya hy atma-vibhutayau yabhir vibhutibhir lokan imaas tvaa vyapya tinohasi
translation: Please tell me in detail of Your divine powers by which You pervade all these worlds and abide in them.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: kathaà vidyäm ahaà yogiàs tväà sadä paricintayan keñu keñu ca bhäveñu cintyo ’si bhagavan mayä
transliteration: kathaa vidyam ahaa yogias tvaa sada paricintayan kenu kenu ca bhavenu cintyo 'si bhagavan maya
translation: How should I meditate on You? In what various forms are You to be contemplated, O Blessed Lord?
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: vistareëätmano yogaà vibhütià ca janärdana bhüyaù kathaya tåptir hi çåëvato nästi me ’måtam
transliteration: vistareeatmano yogaa vibhutia ca janardana bhuyau kathaya taptir hi caevato nasti me 'matam
translation: Tell me again in detail, O Janärdana [Kåñëa], of Your mighty potencies and glories, for I never tire of hearing Your ambrosial words.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çré-bhagavän uväca hanta te kathayiñyämi divyä hy ätma-vibhütayaù prädhänyataù kuru-çreñöha nästy anto vistarasya me
transliteration: cre-bhagavan uvaca hanta te kathayinyami divya hy atma-vibhutayau pradhanyatau kuru-crenoha nasty anto vistarasya me
translation: The Blessed Lord said: Yes, I will tell you of My splendorous manifestations, but only of those which are prominent, O Arjuna, for My opulence is limitless.

glossary.gloss: the Supreme Personality of Godhead said

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: aham ätmä guòäkeça sarva-bhütäçaya-sthitaù aham ädiç ca madhyaà ca bhütänäm anta eva ca
transliteration: aham atma guoakeca sarva-bhutacaya-sthitau aham adic ca madhyaa ca bhutanam anta eva ca
translation: I am the Self, O Guòäkeça, seated in the hearts of all creatures. I am the beginning, the middle and the end of all beings.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ädityänäm ahaà viñëur jyotiñäà ravir aàçumän marécir marutäm asmi nakñaträëäm ahaà çaçé
transliteration: adityanam ahaa vineur jyotinaa ravir aacuman marecir marutam asmi naknatraeam ahaa cace
translation: Of the Ädityas I am Viñëu, of lights I am the radiant sun, I am Maréci of the Maruts, and among the stars I am the moon.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: vedänäà säma-vedo ’smi devänäm asmi väsavaù indriyäëäà manaç cäsmi bhütänäm asmi cetanä
transliteration: vedanaa sama-vedo 'smi devanam asmi vasavau indriyaeaa manac casmi bhutanam asmi cetana
translation: Of the Vedas I am the Säma-veda; of the demigods I am Indra; of the senses I am the mind, and in living beings I am the living force [knowledge].
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: rudräëäà çaìkaraç cäsmi vitteço yakña-rakñasäm vasünäà pävakaç cäsmi meruù çikhariëäm aham
transliteration: rudraeaa caikarac casmi vitteco yakna-raknasam vasunaa pavakac casmi meruu cikharieam aham
translation: Of all the Rudras I am Lord Çiva; of the Yakñas and Räkñasas I am the lord of wealth [Kuvera]; of theVasus I am fire [Agni], and of the mountains I am Meru.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: purodhasäà ca mukhyaà mäà viddhi pärtha båhaspatim senänénäm ahaà skandaù sarasäm asmi sägaraù
transliteration: purodhasaa ca mukhyaa maa viddhi partha bahaspatim senanenam ahaa skandau sarasam asmi sagarau
translation: Of priests, O Arjuna, know Me to be the chief, Båhaspati, the lord of devotion. Of generals I am Skanda, the lord of war; and of bodies of water I am the ocean.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: maharñéëäà bhågur ahaà giräm asmy ekam akñaram yajïänäà japa-yajïo ’smi sthävaräëäà himälayaù
transliteration: maharneeaa bhagur ahaa giram asmy ekam aknaram yajianaa japa-yajio 'smi sthavaraeaa himalayau
translation: Of the great sages I am Bhågu; of vibrations I am the transcendental om. Of sacrifices I am the chanting of the holy names [japa], and of immovable things I am the Himalayas.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: açvatthaù sarva-våkñäëäà devarñéëäà ca näradaù gandharväëäà citrarathaù siddhänäà kapilo muniù
transliteration: acvatthau sarva-vaknaeaa devarneeaa ca naradau gandharvaeaa citrarathau siddhanaa kapilo muniu
translation: Of all trees I am the holy fig tree, and amongst sages and demigods I am Närada. Of the singers of the gods [Gandharvas] I am Citraratha, and among perfected beings I am the sage Kapila.

glossary.gloss: of all the sages amongst the demigods
the citizens of the Gandharva planet
of all those who are perfected

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: uccaiùçravasam açvänäà viddhi mäm amåtodbhavam airävataà gajendräëäà naräëäà ca narädhipam
transliteration: uccaiucravasam acvanaa viddhi mam amatodbhavam airavataa gajendraeaa naraeaa ca naradhipam
translation: Of horses know Me to be Uccaiùçravä, who rose out of the ocean, born of the elixir of immortality; of lordly elephants I am Airävata, and among men I am the monarch.

glossary.gloss: produced from the churning of the ocean

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: äyudhänäm ahaà vajraà dhenünäm asmi kämadhuk prajanaç cäsmi kandarpaù sarpäëäm asmi väsukiù
transliteration: ayudhanam ahaa vajraa dhenunam asmi kamadhuk prajanac casmi kandarpau sarpaeam asmi vasukiu
translation: Of weapons I am the thunderbolt; among cows I am the surabhi, givers of abundant milk. Of procreators I am Kandarpa, the god of love, and of serpents I am Väsuki, the chief.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: anantaç cäsmi nägänäà varuëo yädasäm aham pitèëäm aryamä cäsmi yamaù saàyamatäm aham
transliteration: anantac casmi naganaa varueo yadasam aham piteeam aryama casmi yamau saayamatam aham
translation: Of the celestial Näga snakes I am Ananta; of the aquatic deities I am Varuëa. Of departed ancestors I am Aryamä, and among the dispensers of law I am Yama, lord of death.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: prahlädaç cäsmi daityänäà kälaù kalayatäm aham mågäëäà ca mågendro ’haà vainateyaç ca pakñiëäm
transliteration: prahladac casmi daityanaa kalau kalayatam aham magaeaa ca magendro 'haa vainateyac ca paknieam
translation: Among the Daitya demons I am the devoted Prahläda; among subduers I am time; among the beasts I am the lion, and among birds I am Garuòa, the feathered carrier of Viñëu.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: pavanaù pavatäm asmi rämaù çastra-bhåtäm aham jhañäëäà makaraç cäsmi srotasäm asmi jähnavé
transliteration: pavanau pavatam asmi ramau castra-bhatam aham jhanaeaa makarac casmi srotasam asmi jahnave
translation: Of purifiers I am the wind; of the wielders of weapons I am Räma; of fishes I am the shark, and of flowing rivers I am the Ganges.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sargäëäm ädir antaç ca madhyaà caiväham arjuna adhyätma-vidyä vidyänäà vädaù pravadatäm aham
transliteration: sargaeam adir antac ca madhyaa caivaham arjuna adhyatma-vidya vidyanaa vadau pravadatam aham
translation: Of all creations I am the beginning and the end and also the middle, O Arjuna. Of all sciences I am the spiritual science of the Self, and among logicians I am the conclusive truth.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: akñaräëäm a-käro ’smi dvandvaù sämäsikasya ca aham eväkñayaù kälo dhätähaà viçvato-mukhaù
transliteration: aknaraeam a-karo 'smi dvandvau samasikasya ca aham evaknayau kalo dhatahaa vicvato-mukhau
translation: Of letters I am the letter A, and among compounds I am the dual word. I am also inexhaustable time, and of creators I am Brahmä, whose manifold faces turn everywhere.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: måtyuù sarva-haraç cäham udbhavaç ca bhaviñyatäm kértiù çrér väk ca näréëäà småtir medhä dhåtiù kñamä
transliteration: matyuu sarva-harac caham udbhavac ca bhavinyatam kertiu crer vak ca nareeaa smatir medha dhatiu knama
translation: I am all-devouring death, and I am the generator of all things yet to be. Among women I am fame, fortune, speech, memory, intelligence, faithfulness and patience.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: båhat-säma tathä sämnäà gäyatré chandasäm aham mäsänäà märga-çérño ’ham åtünäà kusumäkaraù
transliteration: bahat-sama tatha samnaa gayatre chandasam aham masanaa marga-cerno 'ham atunaa kusumakarau
translation: Of hymns I am the Båhat-säma sung to the Lord Indra, and of poetry I am the Gäyatré verse, sung daily by brähmaëas. Of months I am November and December, and of seasons I am flower-bearing spring.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: dyütaà chalayatäm asmi tejas tejasvinäm aham jayo ’smi vyavasäyo ’smi sattvaà sattvavatäm aham
transliteration: dyutaa chalayatam asmi tejas tejasvinam aham jayo 'smi vyavasayo 'smi sattvaa sattvavatam aham
translation: I am also the gambling of cheats, and of the splendid I am the splendor. I am victory, I am adventure, and I am the strength of the strong.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: våñëénäà väsudevo ’smi päëòavänäà dhanaïjayaù munénäm apy ahaà vyäsaù kavénäm uçanä kaviù
transliteration: vaneenaa vasudevo 'smi paeoavanaa dhanaijayau munenam apy ahaa vyasau kavenam ucana kaviu
translation: Of the descendants of Våñëi I am Väsudeva, and of the Päëòavas I am Arjuna. Of the sages I am Vyäsa, and among great thinkers I am Uçanä.

glossary.gloss: Vyäsa, the compiler of all Vedic literature

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: daëòo damayatäm asmi nétir asmi jigéñatäm maunaà caiväsmi guhyänäà jïänaà jïänavatäm aham
transliteration: daeoo damayatam asmi netir asmi jigenatam maunaa caivasmi guhyanaa jianaa jianavatam aham
translation: Among punishments I am the rod of chastisement, and of those who seek victory, I am morality. Of secret things I am silence, and of the wise I am wisdom.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yac cäpi sarva-bhütänäà béjaà tad aham arjuna na tad asti vinä yat syän mayä bhütaà caräcaram
transliteration: yac capi sarva-bhutanaa bejaa tad aham arjuna na tad asti vina yat syan maya bhutaa caracaram
translation: Furthermore, O Arjuna, I am the generating seed of all existences. There is no being—moving or unmoving—that can exist without Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: nänto ’sti mama divyänäà vibhüténäà parantapa eña tüddeçataù prokto vibhüter vistaro mayä
transliteration: nanto 'sti mama divyanaa vibhutenaa parantapa ena tuddecatau prokto vibhuter vistaro maya
translation: O mighty conqueror of enemies, there is no end to My divine manifestations. What I have spoken to you is but a mere indication of My infinite opulences.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yad yad vibhütimat sattvaà çrémad ürjitam eva vä tat tad evävagaccha tvaà mama tejo-’àça-sambhavam
transliteration: yad yad vibhutimat sattvaa cremad urjitam eva va tat tad evavagaccha tvaa mama tejo-'aca-sambhavam
translation: Know that all beautiful, glorious, and mighty creations spring from but a spark of My splendor.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: atha vä bahunaitena kià jïätena tavärjuna viñöabhyäham idaà kåtsnam ekäàçena sthito jagat
transliteration: atha va bahunaitena kia jiatena tavarjuna vinoabhyaham idaa katsnam ekaacena sthito jagat
translation: But what need is there, Arjuna, for all this detailed knowledge? With a single fragment of Myself I pervade and support this entire universe.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: arjuna uväca mad-anugrahäya paramaà guhyam adhyätma-saàjïitam yat tvayoktaà vacas tena moho ’yaà vigato mama
transliteration: arjuna uvaca mad-anugrahaya paramaa guhyam adhyatma-saajiitam yat tvayoktaa vacas tena moho 'yaa vigato mama
translation: Arjuna said: I have heard Your instruction on confidential spiritual matters which You have so kindly delivered unto me, and my illusion is now dispelled.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: bhaväpyayau hi bhütänäà çrutau vistaraço mayä tvattaù kamala-paträkña mähätmyam api cävyayam
transliteration: bhavapyayau hi bhutanaa crutau vistaraco maya tvattau kamala-patrakna mahatmyam api cavyayam
translation: O lotus-eyed one, I have heard from You in detail about the appearance and disappearance of every living entity, as realized through Your inexhaustible glories.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: evam etad yathättha tvam ätmänaà parameçvara drañöum icchämi te rüpam aiçvaraà puruñottama
transliteration: evam etad yathattha tvam atmanaa paramecvara dranoum icchami te rupam aicvaraa purunottama
translation: O greatest of all personalities, O supreme form, though I see here before me Your actual position, I yet wish to see how You have entered into this cosmic manifestation. I want to see that form of Yours.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: manyase yadi tac chakyaà mayä drañöum iti prabho yogeçvara tato me tvaà darçayätmänam avyayam
transliteration: manyase yadi tac chakyaa maya dranoum iti prabho yogecvara tato me tvaa darcayatmanam avyayam
translation: If You think that I am able to behold Your cosmic form, O my Lord, O master of all mystic power, then kindly show me that universal self.

glossary.gloss: the Lord of all mystic power

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çré-bhagavän uväca paçya me pärtha rüpäëi çataço ’tha sahasraçaù nänä-vidhäni divyäni nänä-varëäkåténi ca
transliteration: cre-bhagavan uvaca pacya me partha rupaei cataco 'tha sahasracau nana-vidhani divyani nana-vareakateni ca
translation: The Blessed Lord said: My dear Arjuna, O son of Påthä, behold now My opulences, hundreds of thousands of varied divine forms, multicolored like the sea.

glossary.gloss: the Supreme Personality of Godhead said

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: paçyädityän vasün rudrän açvinau marutas tathä bahüny adåñöa-pürväëi paçyäçcaryäëi bhärata
transliteration: pacyadityan vasun rudran acvinau marutas tatha bahuny adanoa-purvaei pacyaccaryaei bharata
translation: O best of the Bhäratas, see here the different manifestations of Ädityas, Rudras, and all the demigods. Behold the many things which no one has ever seen or heard before.

glossary.gloss: the fortynine Maruts (demigods of the wind)
that you have not heard or seen

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ihaika-sthaà jagat kåtsnaà paçyädya sa-caräcaram mama dehe guòäkeça yac cänyad drañöum icchasi
transliteration: ihaika-sthaa jagat katsnaa pacyadya sa-caracaram mama dehe guoakeca yac canyad dranoum icchasi
translation: Whatever you wish to see can be seen all at once in this body. This universal form can show you all that you now desire, as well as whatever you may desire in the future. Everything is here completely.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: na tu mäà çakyase drañöum anenaiva sva-cakñuñä divyaà dadämi te cakñuù paçya me yogam aiçvaram
transliteration: na tu maa cakyase dranoum anenaiva sva-caknuna divyaa dadami te caknuu pacya me yogam aicvaram
translation: But you cannot see Me with your present eyes. Therefore I give to you divine eyes by which you can behold My mystic opulence.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: saïjaya uväca evam uktvä tato räjan mahä-yogeçvaro hariù darçayäm äsa pärthäya paramaà rüpam aiçvaram
transliteration: saijaya uvaca evam uktva tato rajan maha-yogecvaro hariu darcayam asa parthaya paramaa rupam aicvaram
translation: Saïjaya said: O King, speaking thus, the Supreme, the Lord of all mystic power, the Personality of Godhead, displayed His universal form to Arjuna.

glossary.gloss: the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kåñëa

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: aneka-vaktra-nayanam anekädbhuta-darçanam aneka-divyäbharaëaà divyänekodyatäyudham
transliteration: aneka-vaktra-nayanam anekadbhuta-darcanam aneka-divyabharaeaa divyanekodyatayudham
translation: Arjuna saw in that universal form unlimited mouths and unlimited eyes. It was all wondrous. The form was decorated with divine, dazzling ornaments and arrayed in many garbs. He was garlanded gloriously, and there were many scents smeared over His body. All was magnificent, all-expanding, unlimited. This was seen by Arjuna.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: divya-mälyämbara-dharaà divya-gandhänulepanam sarväçcarya-mayaà devam anantaà viçvato-mukham
transliteration: divya-malyambara-dharaa divya-gandhanulepanam sarvaccarya-mayaa devam anantaa vicvato-mukham
translation: Arjuna saw in that universal form unlimited mouths and unlimited eyes. It was all wondrous. The form was decorated with divine, dazzling ornaments and arrayed in many garbs. He was garlanded gloriously, and there were many scents smeared over His body. All was magnificent, all-expanding, unlimited. This was seen by Arjuna.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: divi sürya-sahasrasya bhaved yugapad utthitä yadi bhäù sadåçé sä syäd bhäsas tasya mahätmanaù
transliteration: divi surya-sahasrasya bhaved yugapad utthita yadi bhau sadace sa syad bhasas tasya mahatmanau
translation: If hundreds of thousands of suns rose up at once into the sky, they might resemble the effulgence of the Supreme Person in that universal form.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: tatraika-sthaà jagat kåtsnaà pravibhaktam anekadhä apaçyad deva-devasya çarére päëòavas tadä
transliteration: tatraika-sthaa jagat katsnaa pravibhaktam anekadha apacyad deva-devasya carere paeoavas tada
translation: At that time Arjuna could see in the universal form of the Lord the unlimited expansions of the universe situated in one place although divided into many, many thousands.

glossary.gloss: of the Supreme Personality of Godhead

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: tataù sa vismayäviñöo håñöa-romä dhanaïjayaù praëamya çirasä devaà kåtäïjalir abhäñata
transliteration: tatau sa vismayavinoo hanoa-roma dhanaijayau praeamya cirasa devaa kataijalir abhanata
translation: Then, bewildered and astonished, his hair standing on end, Arjuna began to pray with folded hands, offering obeisances to the Supreme Lord.

glossary.gloss: with his bodily hairs standing on end due to his great ecstasy
to the Supreme Personality of Godhead

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: arjuna uväca paçyämi deväàs tava deva dehe sarväàs tathä bhüta-viçeña-saìghän brahmäëam éçaà kamaläsana-stham åñéàç ca sarvän uragäàç ca divyän
transliteration: arjuna uvaca pacyami devaas tava deva dehe sarvaas tatha bhuta-vicena-saighan brahmaeam ecaa kamalasana-stham aneac ca sarvan uragaac ca divyan
translation: Arjuna said: My dear Lord Kåñëa, I see assembled together in Your body all the demigods and various other living entities. I see Brahmä sitting on the lotus flower as well as Lord Çiva and many sages and divine serpents.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: aneka-bähüdara-vaktra-netraà paçyämi tväà sarvato ’nanta-rüpam näntaà na madhyaà na punas tavädià paçyämi viçveçvara viçva-rüpa
transliteration: aneka-bahudara-vaktra-netraa pacyami tvaa sarvato 'nanta-rupam nantaa na madhyaa na punas tavadia pacyami vicvecvara vicva-rupa
translation: O Lord of the universe, I see in Your universal body many, many forms— bellies, mouths, eyes—expanded without limit. There is no end, there is no beginning, and there is no middle to all this.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: kiréöinaà gadinaà cakriëaà ca tejo-räçià sarvato déptimantam paçyämi tväà durnirékñyaà samantäd déptänalärka-dyutim aprameyam
transliteration: kireoinaa gadinaa cakrieaa ca tejo-racia sarvato deptimantam pacyami tvaa durnireknyaa samantad deptanalarka-dyutim aprameyam
translation: Your form, adorned with various crowns, clubs and discs, is difficult to see because of its glaring effulgence, which is fiery and immeasurable like the sun.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: tvam akñaraà paramaà veditavyaà tvam asya viçvasya paraà nidhänam tvam avyayaù çäçvata-dharma-goptä sanätanas tvaà puruño mato me
transliteration: tvam aknaraa paramaa veditavyaa tvam asya vicvasya paraa nidhanam tvam avyayau cacvata-dharma-gopta sanatanas tvaa puruno mato me
translation: You are the supreme primal objective; You are the best in all the universes; You are inexhaustible, and You are the oldest; You are the maintainer of religion, the eternal Personality of Godhead.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: anädi-madhyäntam ananta-véryam ananta-bähuà çaçi-sürya-netram paçyämi tväà dépta-hutäça-vaktraà sva-tejasä viçvam idaà tapantam
transliteration: anadi-madhyantam ananta-veryam ananta-bahua caci-surya-netram pacyami tvaa depta-hutaca-vaktraa sva-tejasa vicvam idaa tapantam
translation: You are the origin without beginning, middle or end. You have numberless arms, and the sun and moon are among Your great unlimited eyes. By Your own radiance You are heating this entire universe.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: dyäv ä-påthivyor idam antaraà hi vyäptaà tvayaikena diçaç ca sarväù dåñövädbhutaà rüpam ugraà tavedaà loka-trayaà pravyathitaà mahätman
transliteration: dyav a-pathivyor idam antaraa hi vyaptaa tvayaikena dicac ca sarvau danovadbhutaa rupam ugraa tavedaa loka-trayaa pravyathitaa mahatman
translation: Although You are one, You are spread throughout the sky and the planets and all space between. O great one, as I behold this terrible form, I see that all the planetary systems are perplexed.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: amé hi tväà sura-saìghä viçanti kecid bhétäù präïjalayo gåëanti svastéty uktvä maharñi-siddha-saìghäù stuvanti tväà stutibhiù puñkaläbhiù
transliteration: ame hi tvaa sura-saigha vicanti kecid bhetau praijalayo gaeanti svastety uktva maharni-siddha-saighau stuvanti tvaa stutibhiu punkalabhiu
translation: All the demigods are surrendering and entering into You. They are very much afraid, and with folded hands they are singing the Vedic hymns.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: rudrädityä vasavo ye ca sädhyä viçve ’çvinau marutaç coñmapäç ca gandharva-yakñäsura-siddha-saìghä vékñante tväà vismitäç caiva sarve
transliteration: rudraditya vasavo ye ca sadhya vicve 'cvinau marutac conmapac ca gandharva-yaknasura-siddha-saigha veknante tvaa vismitac caiva sarve
translation: The different manifestations of Lord Çiva, the Ädityas, the Vasus, the Sädhyas, the Viçvadevas, the two Açvins, the Märuts, the forefathers and the Gandharvas, the Yakñas, Asuras, and all perfected demigods are beholding You in wonder.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: rüpaà mahat te bahu-vaktra-netraà mahä-bäho bahu-bähüru-pädam bahüdaraà bahu-daàñörä-karälaà dåñövä lokäù pravyathitäs tathäham
transliteration: rupaa mahat te bahu-vaktra-netraa maha-baho bahu-bahuru-padam bahudaraa bahu-daanora-karalaa danova lokau pravyathitas tathaham
translation: O mighty-armed one, all the planets with their demigods are disturbed at seeing Your many faces, eyes, arms, bellies and legs and Your terrible teeth, and as they are disturbed, so am I.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: nabhaù-spåçaà déptam aneka-varëaà vyättänanaà dépta-viçäla-netram dåñövä hi tväà pravyathitäntar-ätmä dhåtià na vindämi çamaà ca viñëo
transliteration: nabhau-spacaa deptam aneka-vareaa vyattananaa depta-vicala-netram danova hi tvaa pravyathitantar-atma dhatia na vindami camaa ca vineo
translation: O all-pervading Viñëu, I can no longer maintain my equilibrium. Seeing Your radiant colors fill the skies and beholding Your eyes and mouths, I am afraid.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: daàñörä-karäläni ca te mukhäni dåñövaiva kälänala-sannibhäni diço na jäne na labhe ca çarma praséda deveça jagan-niväsa
transliteration: daanora-karalani ca te mukhani danovaiva kalanala-sannibhani dico na jane na labhe ca carma praseda deveca jagan-nivasa
translation: O Lord of lords, O refuge of the worlds, please be gracious to me. I cannot keep my balance seeing thus Your blazing deathlike faces and awful teeth. In all directions I am bewildered.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: amé ca tväà dhåtaräñörasya puträù sarve sahaivävani-päla-saìghaiù bhéñmo droëaù süta-putras tathäsau sahäsmadéyair api yodha-mukhyaiù
transliteration: ame ca tvaa dhataranorasya putrau sarve sahaivavani-pala-saighaiu bhenmo droeau suta-putras tathasau sahasmadeyair api yodha-mukhyaiu
translation: All the sons of Dhåtaräñöra along with their allied kings, and Bhéñma, Droëa and Karëa, and all our soldiers are rushing into Your mouths, their heads smashed by Your fearful teeth. I see that some are being crushed between Your teeth as well.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: vakträëi te tvaramäëä viçanti daàñörä-karäläni bhayänakäni kecid vilagnä daçanäntareñu sandåçyante cürëitair uttamäìgaiù
transliteration: vaktraei te tvaramaea vicanti daanora-karalani bhayanakani kecid vilagna dacanantarenu sandacyante cureitair uttamaigaiu
translation: All the sons of Dhåtaräñöra along with their allied kings, and Bhéñma, Droëa and Karëa, and all our soldiers are rushing into Your mouths, their heads smashed by Your fearful teeth. I see that some are being crushed between Your teeth as well.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yathä nadénäà bahavo ’mbu-vegäù samudram eväbhimukhä dravanti tathä tavämé nara-loka-vérä viçanti vakträëy abhivijvalanti
transliteration: yatha nadenaa bahavo 'mbu-vegau samudram evabhimukha dravanti tatha tavame nara-loka-vera vicanti vaktraey abhivijvalanti
translation: As the rivers flow into the sea, so all these great warriors enter Your blazing mouths and perish.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yathä pradéptaà jvalanaà pataìgä viçanti näçäya samåddha-vegäù tathaiva näçäya viçanti lokäs taväpi vakträëi samåddha-vegäù
transliteration: yatha pradeptaa jvalanaa pataiga vicanti nacaya samaddha-vegau tathaiva nacaya vicanti lokas tavapi vaktraei samaddha-vegau
translation: I see all people rushing with full speed into Your mouths as moths dash into a blazing fire.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: lelihyase grasamänaù samantäl lokän samagrän vadanair jvaladbhiù tejobhir äpürya jagat samagraà bhäsas tavogräù pratapanti viñëo
transliteration: lelihyase grasamanau samantal lokan samagran vadanair jvaladbhiu tejobhir apurya jagat samagraa bhasas tavograu pratapanti vineo
translation: O Viñëu, I see You devouring all people in Your flaming mouths and covering the universe with Your immeasurable rays. Scorching the worlds, You are manifest.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: äkhyähi me ko bhavän ugra-rüpo namo ’stu te deva-vara praséda vijïätum icchämi bhavantam ädyaà na hi prajänämi tava pravåttim
transliteration: akhyahi me ko bhavan ugra-rupo namo 'stu te deva-vara praseda vijiatum icchami bhavantam adyaa na hi prajanami tava pravattim
translation: O Lord of lords, so fierce of form, please tell me who You are. I offer my obeisances unto You; please be gracious to me. I do not know what Your mission is, and I desire to hear of it.

glossary.gloss: the great one amongst the demigods

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çré-bhagavän uväca kälo ’smi loka-kñaya-kåt pravåddho lokän samähartum iha pravåttaù åte ’pi tväà na bhaviñyanti sarve ye ’vasthitäù pratyanékeñu yodhäù
transliteration: cre-bhagavan uvaca kalo 'smi loka-knaya-kat pravaddho lokan samahartum iha pravattau ate 'pi tvaa na bhavinyanti sarve ye 'vasthitau pratyanekenu yodhau
translation: The Blessed Lord said: Time I am, destroyer of the worlds, and I have come to engage all people. With the exception of you [the Päëòavas], all the soldiers here on both sides will be slain.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: tasmät tvam uttiñöha yaço labhasva jitvä çatrün bhuìkñva räjyaà samåddham mayaivaite nihatäù pürvam eva nimitta-mätraà bhava savya-säcin
transliteration: tasmat tvam uttinoha yaco labhasva jitva catrun bhuiknva rajyaa samaddham mayaivaite nihatau purvam eva nimitta-matraa bhava savya-sacin
translation: Therefore get up and prepare to fight. After conquering your enemies you will enjoy a flourishing kingdom. They are already put to death by My arrangement, and you, O Savyasäcin, can be but an instmment in the fight.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: droëaà ca bhéñmaà ca jayadrathaà ca karëaà tathänyän api yodha-vérän mayä hatäàs tvaà jahi mä vyathiñöhä yudhyasva jetäsi raëe sapatnän
transliteration: droeaa ca bhenmaa ca jayadrathaa ca kareaa tathanyan api yodha-veran maya hataas tvaa jahi ma vyathinoha yudhyasva jetasi raee sapatnan
translation: The Blessed Lord said: All the great warriors—Droëa, Bhéñma, Jayadratha, Karëa—are already destroyed. Simply fight, and you will vanquish your enemies.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: saïjaya uväca etac chrutvä vacanaà keçavasya kåtäïjalir vepamänaù kirété namaskåtvä bhüya eväha kåñëaà sa-gadgadaà bhéta-bhétaù praëamya
transliteration: saijaya uvaca etac chrutva vacanaa kecavasya kataijalir vepamanau kirete namaskatva bhuya evaha kaneaa sa-gadgadaa bheta-bhetau praeamya
translation: Saïjaya said to Dhåtaräñöra: O King, after hearing these words from the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Arjuna trembled, fearfully offered obeisances with folded hands and began, falteringly, to speak as follows:
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: arjuna uväca sthäne håñékeça tava prakértyä jagat prahåñyaty anurajyate ca rakñäàsi bhétäni diço dravanti sarve namasyanti ca siddha-saìghäù
transliteration: arjuna uvaca sthane hanekeca tava prakertya jagat prahanyaty anurajyate ca raknaasi bhetani dico dravanti sarve namasyanti ca siddha-saighau
translation: O Håñékeça, the world becomes joyful upon hearing Your name and thus everyone becomes attached to You. Although the perfected beings offer You their respectful homage, the demons are afraid, and they flee here and there. All this is rightly done.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: kasmäc ca te na nameran mahätman garéyase brahmaëo ’py ädi-kartre ananta deveça jagan-niväsa tvam akñaraà sad-asat tat paraà yat
transliteration: kasmac ca te na nameran mahatman gareyase brahmaeo 'py adi-kartre ananta deveca jagan-nivasa tvam aknaraa sad-asat tat paraa yat
translation: O great one, who stands above even Brahmä, You are the original master. Why should they not offer their homage up to You, O limitless one? O refuge of the universe, You are the invincible source, the cause of all causes, transcendental to this material manifestation.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: tvam ädi-devaù puruñaù puräëas tvam asya viçvasya paraà nidhänam vettäsi vedyaà ca paraà ca dhäma tvayä tataà viçvam ananta-rüpa
transliteration: tvam adi-devau purunau puraeas tvam asya vicvasya paraa nidhanam vettasi vedyaa ca paraa ca dhama tvaya tataa vicvam ananta-rupa
translation: You are the original Personality, the Godhead. You are the only sanctuary of this manifested cosmic world. You know everything, and You are all that is knowable. You are above the material modes. O limitless form! This whole cosmic manifestation is pervaded by You!
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: väyur yamo ’gnir varuëaù çaçäìkaù prajäpatis tvaà prapitämahaç ca namo namas te ’stu sahasra-kåtvaù punaç ca bhüyo ’pi namo namas te
transliteration: vayur yamo 'gnir varueau cacaikau prajapatis tvaa prapitamahac ca namo namas te 'stu sahasra-katvau punac ca bhuyo 'pi namo namas te
translation: You are air, fire, water, and You are the moon! You are the supreme controller and the grandfather. Thus I offer my respectful obeisances unto You a thousand times, and again and yet again!

glossary.gloss: again I offer my respects unto You

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: namaù purastäd atha påñöhatas te namo ’stu te sarvata eva sarva ananta-véryämita-vikramas tvaà sarvaà samäpnoñi tato ’si sarvaù
transliteration: namau purastad atha panohatas te namo 'stu te sarvata eva sarva ananta-veryamita-vikramas tvaa sarvaa samapnoni tato 'si sarvau
translation: Obeisances from the front, from behind and from all sides! O unbounded power, You are the master of limitless, might! You are all-pervading, and thus You are everything!
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sakheti matvä prasabhaà yad uktaà he kåñëa he yädava he sakheti ajänatä mahimänaà tavedaà mayä pramädät praëayena väpi
transliteration: sakheti matva prasabhaa yad uktaa he kanea he yadava he sakheti ajanata mahimanaa tavedaa maya pramadat praeayena vapi
translation: I have in the past addressed You as “O Kåñëa,” “O Yädava,” “O my friend,” without knowing Your glories. Please forgive whatever I may have done in madness or in love. I have dishonored You many times while relaxing or while lying on the same bed or eating together, sometimes alone and sometimes in front of many friends. Please excuse me for all my offenses.

glossary.gloss: O my dear friend, ajänatä—without knowing

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yac cävahäsärtham asat-kåto ’si vihära-çayyäsana-bhojaneñu eko ’tha väpy acyuta tat-samakñaà tat kñämaye tväm aham aprameyam
transliteration: yac cavahasartham asat-kato 'si vihara-cayyasana-bhojanenu eko 'tha vapy acyuta tat-samaknaa tat knamaye tvam aham aprameyam
translation: I have in the past addressed You as “O Kåñëa,” “O Yädava,” “O my friend,” without knowing Your glories. Please forgive whatever I may have done in madness or in love. I have dishonored You many times while relaxing or while lying on the same bed or eating together, sometimes alone and sometimes in front of many friends. Please excuse me for all my offenses.

glossary.gloss: O my dear friend, ajänatä—without knowing

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: pitäsi lokasya caräcarasya tvam asya püjyaç ca gurur garéyän na tvat-samo ’sty abhyadhikaù kuto ’nyo loka-traye ’py apratima-prabhäva
transliteration: pitasi lokasya caracarasya tvam asya pujyac ca gurur gareyan na tvat-samo 'sty abhyadhikau kuto 'nyo loka-traye 'py apratima-prabhava
translation: You are the father of this complete cosmic manifestation, the worshipable chief, the spiritual master. No one is equal to You, nor can anyone be one with You. Within the three worlds, You are immeasurable.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: tasmät praëamya praëidhäya käyaà prasädaye tväm aham éçam éòyam piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuù priyaù priyäyärhasi deva soòhum
transliteration: tasmat praeamya praeidhaya kayaa prasadaye tvam aham ecam eoyam piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuu priyau priyayarhasi deva soohum
translation: You are the Supreme Lord, to be worshiped by every living being. Thus I fall down to offer You my respects and ask Your mercy. Please tolerate the wrongs that I may have done to You and bear with me as a father with his son, or a friend with his friend, or a lover with his beloved.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: adåñöa-pürvaà håñito ’smi dåñövä bhayena ca pravyathitaà mano me tad eva me darçaya deva rüpaà praséda deveça jagan-niväsa
transliteration: adanoa-purvaa hanito 'smi danova bhayena ca pravyathitaa mano me tad eva me darcaya deva rupaa praseda deveca jagan-nivasa
translation: After seeing this universal form, which I have never seen before, I am gladdened, but at the same time my mind is disturbed with fear. Therefore please bestow Your grace upon me and reveal again Your form as the Personality of Godhead, O Lord of lords, O abode of the universe.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: kiréöinaà gadinaà cakra-hastam icchämi tväà drañöum ahaà tathaiva tenaiva rüpeëa catur-bhujena sahasra-bäho bhava viçva-mürte
transliteration: kireoinaa gadinaa cakra-hastam icchami tvaa dranoum ahaa tathaiva tenaiva rupeea catur-bhujena sahasra-baho bhava vicva-murte
translation: O universal Lord, I wish to see You in Your four-armed form, with helmeted head and with club, wheel, conch and lotus flower in Your hands. I long to see You in that form.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çré-bhagavän uväca mayä prasannena tavärjunedaà rüpaà paraà darçitam ätma-yogät tejo-mayaà viçvam anantam ädyaà yan me tvad anyena na dåñöa-pürvam
transliteration: cre-bhagavan uvaca maya prasannena tavarjunedaa rupaa paraa darcitam atma-yogat tejo-mayaa vicvam anantam adyaa yan me tvad anyena na danoa-purvam
translation: The Blessed Lord said: My dear Arjuna, happily do I show you this universal form within the material world by My internal potency. No one before you has ever seen this unlimited and glaringly effulgent form.

glossary.gloss: the Supreme Personality of Godhead said

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: na veda-yajïädhyayanair na dänair na ca kriyäbhir na tapobhir ugraiù evaà-rüpaù çakya ahaà nå-loke drañöuà tvad anyena kuru-pravéra
transliteration: na veda-yajiadhyayanair na danair na ca kriyabhir na tapobhir ugraiu evaa-rupau cakya ahaa na-loke dranoua tvad anyena kuru-pravera
translation: O best of the Kuru warriors, no one before you has ever seen this universal form of Mine, for neither by studying the Vedas, nor by performing sacrifices, nor by charities or similar activities can this form be seen. Only you have seen this.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: mä te vyathä mä ca vimüòha-bhävo dåñövä rüpaà ghoram édåì mamedam vyapeta-bhéù préta-manäù punas tvaà tad eva me rüpam idaà prapaçya
transliteration: ma te vyatha ma ca vimuoha-bhavo danova rupaa ghoram edai mamedam vyapeta-bheu preta-manau punas tvaa tad eva me rupam idaa prapacya
translation: Your mind has been perturbed upon seeing this horrible feature of Mine. Now let it be finished. My devotee, be free from all disturbance. With a peaceful mind you can now see the form you desire.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: saïjaya uväca ity arjunaà väsudevas tathoktvä svakaà rüpaà darçayäm äsa bhüyaù äçväsayäm äsa ca bhétam enaà bhütvä punaù saumya-vapur mahätmä
transliteration: saijaya uvaca ity arjunaa vasudevas tathoktva svakaa rupaa darcayam asa bhuyau acvasayam asa ca bhetam enaa bhutva punau saumya-vapur mahatma
translation: Saïjaya said to Dhåtaräñöra: The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kåñëa, while speaking thus to Arjuna, displayed His real four-armed form, and at last He showed him His two-armed form, thus encouraging the fearful Arjuna.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: arjuna uväca dåñövedaà mänuñaà rüpaà tava saumyaà janärdana idäném asmi saàvåttaù sa-cetäù prakåtià gataù
transliteration: arjuna uvaca danovedaa manunaa rupaa tava saumyaa janardana idanem asmi saavattau sa-cetau prakatia gatau
translation: When Arjuna thus saw Kåñëa in His original form, he said: Seeing this humanlike form, so very beautiful, my mind is now pacified, and I am restored to my original nature.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çré-bhagavän uväca su-durdarçam idaà rüpaà dåñöavän asi yan mama devä apy asya rüpasya nityaà darçana-käìkñiëaù
transliteration: cre-bhagavan uvaca su-durdarcam idaa rupaa danoavan asi yan mama deva apy asya rupasya nityaa darcana-kaiknieau
translation: The Blessed Lord said: My dear Arjuna, the form which you are now seeing is very difficult to behold. Even the demigods are ever seeking the opportunity to see this form which is so dear.

glossary.gloss: the Supreme Personality of Godhead said

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: nähaà vedair na tapasä na dänena na cejyayä çakya evaà-vidho drañöuà dåñöavän asi mäà yathä
transliteration: nahaa vedair na tapasa na danena na cejyaya cakya evaa-vidho dranoua danoavan asi maa yatha
translation: The form which you are seeing with your transcendental eyes cannot be understood simply by studying the Vedas, nor by undergoing serious penances, nor by charity, nor by worship. It is not by these means that one can see Me as I am.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: bhaktyä tv ananyayä çakya aham evaà-vidho ’rjuna jïätuà drañöuà ca tattvena praveñöuà ca parantapa
transliteration: bhaktya tv ananyaya cakya aham evaa-vidho 'rjuna jiatua dranoua ca tattvena pravenoua ca parantapa
translation: My dear Arjuna, only by undivided devotional service can I be understood as I am, standing before you, and can thus be seen directly. Only in this way can you enter into the mysteries of My understanding.

glossary.gloss: without being mixed with fruitive activities or speculative knowledge

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: mat-karma-kån mat-paramo mad-bhaktaù saìga-varjitaù nirvairaù sarva-bhüteñu yaù sa mäm eti päëòava
transliteration: mat-karma-kan mat-paramo mad-bhaktau saiga-varjitau nirvairau sarva-bhutenu yau sa mam eti paeoava
translation: My dear Arjuna, one who is engaged in My pure devotional service, free from the contaminations of previous activities and from mental speculation, who is friendly to every living entity, certainly comes to Me.

glossary.gloss: freed from the contamination of previous activities and mental speculation

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: arjuna uväca evaà satata-yuktä ye bhaktäs tväà paryupäsate ye cäpy akñaram avyaktaà teñäà ke yoga-vittamäù
transliteration: arjuna uvaca evaa satata-yukta ye bhaktas tvaa paryupasate ye capy aknaram avyaktaa tenaa ke yoga-vittamau
translation: Arjuna inquired: Which is considered to be more perfect: those who are properly engaged in Your devotional service, or those who worship the impersonal Brahman, the unmanifested?
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çré-bhagavän uväca mayy äveçya mano ye mäà nitya-yuktä upäsate çraddhayä parayopetäs te me yuktatamä matäù
transliteration: cre-bhagavan uvaca mayy avecya mano ye maa nitya-yukta upasate craddhaya parayopetas te me yuktatama matau
translation: The Blessed Lord said: He whose mind is fixed on My personal form, always engaged in worshiping Me with great and transcendental faith, is considered by Me to be most perfect.

glossary.gloss: the Supreme Personality of Godhead said

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ye tv akñaram anirdeçyam avyaktaà paryupäsate sarvatra-gam acintyaà ca küöa-stham acalaà dhruvam
transliteration: ye tv aknaram anirdecyam avyaktaa paryupasate sarvatra-gam acintyaa ca kuoa-stham acalaa dhruvam
translation: But those who fully worship the unmanifested, that which lies beyond the perception of the senses, the all-pervading, inconceivable, fixed, and immovable —the impersonal conception of the Absolute Truth—by controlling the various senses and being equally disposed to everyone, such persons, engaged in the welfare of all, at last achieve Me.

glossary.gloss: which is beyond the perception of the senses

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sanniyamyendriya-grämaà sarvatra sama-buddhayaù te präpnuvanti mäm eva sarva-bhüta-hite ratäù
transliteration: sanniyamyendriya-gramaa sarvatra sama-buddhayau te prapnuvanti mam eva sarva-bhuta-hite ratau
translation: But those who fully worship the unmanifested, that which lies beyond the perception of the senses, the all-pervading, inconceivable, fixed, and immovable —the impersonal conception of the Absolute Truth—by controlling the various senses and being equally disposed to everyone, such persons, engaged in the welfare of all, at last achieve Me.

glossary.gloss: which is beyond the perception of the senses

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: kleço ’dhikataras teñäm avyaktäsakta-cetasäm avyaktä hi gatir duùkhaà dehavadbhir aväpyate
transliteration: kleco 'dhikataras tenam avyaktasakta-cetasam avyakta hi gatir duukhaa dehavadbhir avapyate
translation: For those whose minds are attached to the unmanifested, impersonal feature of the Supreme, advancement is very troublesome. To make progrese in that discipline is always difficult for those who are embodied.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ye tu sarväëi karmäëi mayi sannyasya mat-paräù ananyenaiva yogena mäà dhyäyanta upäsate
transliteration: ye tu sarvaei karmaei mayi sannyasya mat-parau ananyenaiva yogena maa dhyayanta upasate
translation: For one who worships Me, giving up all his activities unto Me and being devoted to Me without deviation, engaged in devotional service and always meditating upon Me, who has fixed his mind upon Me, O son of Påthä, for him I am the swift deliverer from the ocean of birth and death.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: teñäm ahaà samuddhartä måtyu-saàsära-sägarät bhavämi na cirät pärtha mayy äveçita-cetasäm
transliteration: tenam ahaa samuddharta matyu-saasara-sagarat bhavami na cirat partha mayy avecita-cetasam
translation: For one who worships Me, giving up all his activities unto Me and being devoted to Me without deviation, engaged in devotional service and always meditating upon Me, who has fixed his mind upon Me, O son of Påthä, for him I am the swift deliverer from the ocean of birth and death.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: mayy eva mana ädhatsva mayi buddhià niveçaya nivasiñyasi mayy eva ata ürdhvaà na saàçayaù
transliteration: mayy eva mana adhatsva mayi buddhia nivecaya nivasinyasi mayy eva ata urdhvaa na saacayau
translation: Just fix your mind upon Me, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, and engage all your intelligence in Me. Thus you will live in Me always, without a doubt.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: atha cittaà samädhätuà na çaknoñi mayi sthiram abhyäsa-yogena tato mäm icchäptuà dhanaïjaya
transliteration: atha cittaa samadhatua na caknoni mayi sthiram abhyasa-yogena tato mam icchaptua dhanaijaya
translation: My dear Arjuna, O winner of wealth, if you cannot fix your mind upon Me without deviation, then follow the regulated principles of bhakti-yoga In this way you will develop a desire to attain to Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: abhyäse ’py asamartho ’si mat-karma-paramo bhava mad-artham api karmäëi kurvan siddhim aväpsyasi
transliteration: abhyase 'py asamartho 'si mat-karma-paramo bhava mad-artham api karmaei kurvan siddhim avapsyasi
translation: If you cannot practice the regulations of bhakti-yoga, then just try to work for Me, because by working for Me you will come to the perfect stage.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: athaitad apy açakto ’si kartuà mad-yogam äçritaù sarva-karma-phala-tyägaà tataù kuru yatätmavän
transliteration: athaitad apy acakto 'si kartua mad-yogam acritau sarva-karma-phala-tyagaa tatau kuru yatatmavan
translation: If, however, you are unable to work in this consciousness, then try to act giving up all results of your work and try to be self-situated.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çreyo hi jïänam abhyäsäj jïänäd dhyänaà viçiñyate dhyänät karma-phala-tyägas tyägäc chäntir anantaram
transliteration: creyo hi jianam abhyasaj jianad dhyanaa vicinyate dhyanat karma-phala-tyagas tyagac chantir anantaram
translation: If you cannot take to this practice, then engage yourself in the cultivation of knowledge. Better than knowledge, however, is meditation, and better than meditation is renunciation of the fruits of action, for by such renunciation one can attain peace of mind.

glossary.gloss: renunciation of the results of fruitive action

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: adveñöä sarva-bhütänäà maitraù karuëa eva ca nirmamo nirahaìkäraù sama-duùkha-sukhaù kñamé
transliteration: advenoa sarva-bhutanaa maitrau karuea eva ca nirmamo nirahaikarau sama-duukha-sukhau kname
translation: One who is not envious but who is a kind friend to all living entities, who does not think himself a proprietor, who is free from false ego and equal both in happiness and distress, who is always satisfied and engaged in devotional service with determination and whose mind and intelligence are in agreement with Me —he is very dear to Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: santuñöaù satataà yogé yatätmä dåòha-niçcayaù mayy arpita-mano-buddhir yo mad-bhaktaù sa me priyaù
transliteration: santunoau satataa yoge yatatma daoha-niccayau mayy arpita-mano-buddhir yo mad-bhaktau sa me priyau
translation: One who is not envious but who is a kind friend to all living entities, who does not think himself a proprietor, who is free from false ego and equal both in happiness and distress, who is always satisfied and engaged in devotional service with determination and whose mind and intelligence are in agreement with Me —he is very dear to Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yasmän nodvijate loko lokän nodvijate ca yaù harñämarña-bhayodvegair mukto yaù sa ca me priyaù
transliteration: yasman nodvijate loko lokan nodvijate ca yau harnamarna-bhayodvegair mukto yau sa ca me priyau
translation: He for whom no one is put into difficulty and who is not dirturbed by anxiety, who is steady in happiness and distress, is very dear to Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: anapekñaù çucir dakña udäséno gata-vyathaù sarvärambha-parityägé yo mad-bhaktaù sa me priyaù
