translation: But he who performs his prescribed duty only because it ought to be done, and renounces all attachment to the fruit—his renunciation is of the nature of goodness, O Arjuna.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: na dveñöy akuçalaà karma kuçale nänuñajjate tyägé sattva-samäviñöo medhävé chinna-saàçayaù
transliteration: na dvenoy akucalaa karma kucale nanunajjate tyage sattva-samavinoo medhave chinna-saacayau
translation: Those who are situated in the mode of goodness, who neither hate inauspicious work nor are attached to auspicious work, have no doubts about work.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: na hi deha-bhåtä çakyaà tyaktuà karmäëy açeñataù yas tu karma-phala-tyägé sa tyägéty abhidhéyate
transliteration: na hi deha-bhata cakyaa tyaktua karmaey acenatau yas tu karma-phala-tyage sa tyagety abhidheyate
translation: It is indeed impossible for an embodied being to give up all activities. Therefore it is said that he who renounces the fruits of action is one who has truly renounced.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: aniñöam iñöaà miçraà ca tri-vidhaà karmaëaù phalam bhavaty atyäginäà pretya na tu sannyäsinäà kvacit
transliteration: aninoam inoaa micraa ca tri-vidhaa karmaeau phalam bhavaty atyaginaa pretya na tu sannyasinaa kvacit
translation: For one who is not renounced, the threefold fruits of action—desirable, undesirable and mixed—accrue after death. But those who are in the renounced order of life have no such results to suffer or enjoy.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: païcaitäni mahä-bäho käraëäni nibodha me säìkhye kåtänte proktäni siddhaye sarva-karmaëäm
transliteration: paicaitani maha-baho karaeani nibodha me saikhye katante proktani siddhaye sarva-karmaeam
translation: O mighty-armed Arjuna, learn from Me of the five factors which bring about the accomplishment of all action. These are declared in säìkhya philosophy to be the place of action, the performer, the senses, the endeavor, and ultimately the Supersoul.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: adhiñöhänaà tathä kartä karaëaà ca påthag-vidham vividhäç ca påthak ceñöä daivaà caivätra païcamam
transliteration: adhinohanaa tatha karta karaeaa ca pathag-vidham vividhac ca pathak cenoa daivaa caivatra paicamam
translation: O mighty-armed Arjuna, learn from Me of the five factors which bring about the accomplishment of all action. These are declared in säìkhya philosophy to be the place of action, the performer, the senses, the endeavor, and ultimately the Supersoul.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çaréra-väì-manobhir yat karma prärabhate naraù nyäyyaà vä viparétaà vä païcaite tasya hetavaù
transliteration: carera-vai-manobhir yat karma prarabhate narau nyayyaa va viparetaa va paicaite tasya hetavau
translation: Whatever right or wrong action a man performs by body, mind or speech is caused by these five factors.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: tatraivaà sati kartäram ätmänaà kevalaà tu yaù paçyaty akåta-buddhitvän na sa paçyati durmatiù
transliteration: tatraivaa sati kartaram atmanaa kevalaa tu yau pacyaty akata-buddhitvan na sa pacyati durmatiu
translation: Therefore one who thinks himself the only doer, not considering the five factors, is certainly not very intelligent and cannot see things as they are.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yasya nähaìkåto bhävo buddhir yasya na lipyate hatväpi sa imäû lokän na hanti na nibadhyate
transliteration: yasya nahaikato bhavo buddhir yasya na lipyate hatvapi sa imau lokan na hanti na nibadhyate
translation: One who is not motivated by false ego, whose intelligence is not entangled, though he kills men in this world, is not the slayer. Nor is he bound by his actions.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: jïänaà jïeyaà parijïätä tri-vidhä karma-codanä karaëaà karma karteti tri-vidhaù karma-saìgrahaù
transliteration: jianaa jieyaa parijiata tri-vidha karma-codana karaeaa karma karteti tri-vidhau karma-saigrahau
translation: Knowledge, the object of knowledge and the knower are the three factors which motivate action; the senses, the work and the doer comprise the threefold basis of action.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: jïänaà karma ca kartä ca tridhaiva guëa-bhedataù procyate guëa-saìkhyäne yathävac chåëu täny api
transliteration: jianaa karma ca karta ca tridhaiva guea-bhedatau procyate guea-saikhyane yathavac chaeu tany api
translation: In accordance with the three modes of material nature, there are three kinds of knowledge, action, and performers of action. Listen as I describe them.

glossary.gloss: in terms of different modes of material nature

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sarva-bhüteñu yenaikaà bhävam avyayam ékñate avibhaktaà vibhakteñu taj jïänaà viddhi sättvikam
transliteration: sarva-bhutenu yenaikaa bhavam avyayam eknate avibhaktaa vibhaktenu taj jianaa viddhi sattvikam
translation: That knowledge by which one undivided spiritual nature is seen in all existences, undivided in the divided, is knowledge in the mode of goodness.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: påthaktvena tu yaj jïänaà nänä-bhävän påthag-vidhän vetti sarveñu bhüteñu taj jïänaà viddhi räjasam
transliteration: pathaktvena tu yaj jianaa nana-bhavan pathag-vidhan vetti sarvenu bhutenu taj jianaa viddhi rajasam
translation: That knowledge by which a different type of living entity is seen to be dwelling in different bodies is knowledge in the mode of passion.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yat tu kåtsna-vad ekasmin kärye saktam ahaitukam atattvärtha-vad alpaà ca tat tämasam udähåtam
transliteration: yat tu katsna-vad ekasmin karye saktam ahaitukam atattvartha-vad alpaa ca tat tamasam udahatam
translation: And that knowledge by which one is attached to one kind of work as the all in all, without knowledge of the truth, and which is very meager, is said to be in the mode of darkness.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: niyataà saìga-rahitam aräga-dveñataù kåtam aphala-prepsunä karma yat tat sättvikam ucyate
transliteration: niyataa saiga-rahitam araga-dvenatau katam aphala-prepsuna karma yat tat sattvikam ucyate
translation: As for actions, that action in accordance with duty, which is performed without attachment, without love or hate, by one who has renounced fruitive results, is called action in the mode of goodness.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yat tu kämepsunä karma sähaìkäreëa vä punaù kriyate bahuläyäsaà tad räjasam udähåtam
transliteration: yat tu kamepsuna karma sahaikareea va punau kriyate bahulayasaa tad rajasam udahatam
translation: But action performed with great effort by one seeking to gratify his desires, and which is enacted from a sense of false ego, is called action in the mode of passion.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: anubandhaà kñayaà hiàsäm anapekñya ca pauruñam mohäd ärabhyate karma yat tat tämasam ucyate
transliteration: anubandhaa knayaa hiasam anapeknya ca paurunam mohad arabhyate karma yat tat tamasam ucyate
translation: And that action performed in ignorance and delusion without consideration of future bondage or consequences, which inflicts injury and is impractical, is said to be action in the mode of ignorance.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: mukta-saìgo ’nahaà-vädé dhåty-utsäha-samanvitaù siddhy-asiddhyor nirvikäraù kartä sättvika ucyate
transliteration: mukta-saigo 'nahaa-vade dhaty-utsaha-samanvitau siddhy-asiddhyor nirvikarau karta sattvika ucyate
translation: The worker who is free from all material attachments and false ego, who is enthusiastic and resolute and who is indifferent to success or failure, is a worker in the mode of goodness.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: rägé karma-phala-prepsur lubdho hiàsätmako ’çuciù harña-çokänvitaù kartä räjasaù parikértitaù
transliteration: rage karma-phala-prepsur lubdho hiasatmako 'cuciu harna-cokanvitau karta rajasau parikertitau
translation: But that worker who is attached to the fruits of his labor and who passionately wants to enjoy them, who is greedy, envious and impure and moved by happiness and distress, is a worker in the mode of passion.

glossary.gloss: to the fruit of the work

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ayuktaù präkåtaù stabdhaù çaöho naiñkåtiko ’lasaù viñädé dérgha-sütré ca kartä tämasa ucyate
transliteration: ayuktau prakatau stabdhau caoho nainkatiko 'lasau vinade dergha-sutre ca karta tamasa ucyate
translation: And that worker who is always engaged in work against the injunction of the scripture, who is materialistic, obstinate, cheating and expert in insulting others, who is lazy, always morose and procrastinating, is a worker in the mode of ignorance.

glossary.gloss: without reference to the scriptural injunctions

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: buddher bhedaà dhåteç caiva guëatas tri-vidhaà çåëu procyamänam açeñeëa påthaktvena dhanaïjaya
transliteration: buddher bhedaa dhatec caiva gueatas tri-vidhaa caeu procyamanam aceneea pathaktvena dhanaijaya
translation: Now, O winner of wealth, please listen as I tell you in detail of the three kinds of understanding and determination according to the three modes of nature.

glossary.gloss: by the modes of material nature

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: pravåttià ca nivåttià ca käryäkärye bhayäbhaye bandhaà mokñaà ca yä vetti buddhiù sä pärtha sättviké
transliteration: pravattia ca nivattia ca karyakarye bhayabhaye bandhaa moknaa ca ya vetti buddhiu sa partha sattvike
translation: O son of Påthä, that understanding by which one knows what ought to be done and what ought not to be done, what is to be feared and what is not to be feared, what is binding and what is liberating, that understanding is established in the mode of goodness.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yayä dharmam adharmaà ca käryaà cäkäryam eva ca ayathävat prajänäti buddhiù sä pärtha räjasé
transliteration: yaya dharmam adharmaa ca karyaa cakaryam eva ca ayathavat prajanati buddhiu sa partha rajase
translation: And that understanding which cannot distinguish between the religious way of life and the irreligious, between action that should be done and action that should not be done, that imperfect understanding, O son of Påthä, is in the mode of passion.

glossary.gloss: what ought not to be done

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: adharmaà dharmam iti yä manyate tamasävåtä sarvärthän viparétäàç ca buddhiù sä pärtha tämasé
transliteration: adharmaa dharmam iti ya manyate tamasavata sarvarthan viparetaac ca buddhiu sa partha tamase
translation: That understanding which considers irreligion to be religion and religion to be irreligion, under the spell of illusion and darkness, and strives always in the wrong direction, O Pärtha, is in the mode of ignorance.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: dhåtyä yayä dhärayate manaù-präëendriya-kriyäù yogenävyabhicäriëyä dhåtiù sä pärtha sättviké
transliteration: dhatya yaya dharayate manau-praeendriya-kriyau yogenavyabhicarieya dhatiu sa partha sattvike
translation: O son of Påthä, that determination which is unbreakable, which is sustained with steadfastness by yoga practice, and thus controls the mind, life, and the acts of the senses, is in the mode of goodness.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yayä tu dharma-kämärthän dhåtyä dhärayate ’rjuna prasaìgena phaläkäìkñé dhåtiù sä pärtha räjasé
transliteration: yaya tu dharma-kamarthan dhatya dharayate 'rjuna prasaigena phalakaikne dhatiu sa partha rajase
translation: And that determination by which one holds fast to fruitive result in religion, economic development and sense gratification is of the nature of passion, O Arjuna.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yayä svapnaà bhayaà çokaà viñädaà madam eva ca na vimuïcati durmedhä dhåtiù sä pärtha tämasé
transliteration: yaya svapnaa bhayaa cokaa vinadaa madam eva ca na vimuicati durmedha dhatiu sa partha tamase
translation: And that determination which cannot go beyond dreaming, fearfulness, lamentation, moroseness, and illusion—such unintelligent determination is in the mode of darkness.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sukhaà tv idänéà tri-vidhaà çåëu me bharatarñabha abhyäsäd ramate yatra duùkhäntaà ca nigacchati
transliteration: sukhaa tv idanea tri-vidhaa caeu me bharatarnabha abhyasad ramate yatra duukhantaa ca nigacchati
translation: O best of the Bhäratas, now please hear from Me about the three kinds of happiness which the conditioned soul enjoys, and by which he sometimes comes to the end of all distress. That which in the beginning may be just like poison but at the end is just like nectar and which awakens one to self-realization is said to be happiness in the mode of goodness.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yat tad agre viñam iva pariëäme ’måtopamam tat sukhaà sättvikaà proktam ätma-buddhi-prasäda-jam
transliteration: yat tad agre vinam iva parieame 'matopamam tat sukhaa sattvikaa proktam atma-buddhi-prasada-jam
translation: O best of the Bhäratas, now please hear from Me about the three kinds of happiness which the conditioned soul enjoys, and by which he sometimes comes to the end of all distress. That which in the beginning may be just like poison but at the end is just like nectar and which awakens one to self-realization is said to be happiness in the mode of goodness.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: viñayendriya-saàyogäd yat tad agre ’måtopamam pariëäme viñam iva tat sukhaà räjasaà småtam
transliteration: vinayendriya-saayogad yat tad agre 'matopamam parieame vinam iva tat sukhaa rajasaa smatam
translation: That happiness which is derived from contact of the senses with their objects and which appears like nectar at first but poison at the end is said to be of the nature of passion.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yad agre cänubandhe ca sukhaà mohanam ätmanaù nidrälasya-pramädotthaà tat tämasam udähåtam
transliteration: yad agre canubandhe ca sukhaa mohanam atmanau nidralasya-pramadotthaa tat tamasam udahatam
translation: And that happiness which is blind to self-realization, which is delusion from beginning to end and which arises from sleep, laziness and illusion is said to be of the nature of ignorance.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: na tad asti påthivyäà vä divi deveñu vä punaù sattvaà prakåti-jair muktaà yad ebhiù syät tribhir guëaiù
transliteration: na tad asti pathivyaa va divi devenu va punau sattvaa prakati-jair muktaa yad ebhiu syat tribhir gueaiu
translation: There is no being existing, either here or among the demigods in the higher planetary systems, which is freed from the three modes of material nature.

glossary.gloss: under the influence of material nature

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: brähmaëa-kñatriya-viçäà çüdräëäà ca parantapa karmäëi pravibhaktäni svabhäva-prabhavair guëaiù
transliteration: brahmaea-knatriya-vicaa cudraeaa ca parantapa karmaei pravibhaktani svabhava-prabhavair gueaiu
translation: Brähmaëas, kñatriyas, vaiçyas and çüdras are distinguished by their qualities of work, O chastiser of the enemy, in accordance with the modes of nature.

glossary.gloss: by the modes of material nature.

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çamo damas tapaù çaucaà kñäntir ärjavam eva ca jïänaà vijïänam ästikyaà brahma-karma svabhäva-jam
transliteration: camo damas tapau caucaa knantir arjavam eva ca jianaa vijianam astikyaa brahma-karma svabhava-jam
translation: Peacefulness, self-control, austerity, purity, tolerance, honesty, wisdom, knowledge, and religiousness—these are the qualities by which the brähmaëas work.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çauryaà tejo dhåtir däkñyaà yuddhe cäpy apaläyanam dänam éçvara-bhävaç ca kñätraà karma svabhäva-jam
transliteration: cauryaa tejo dhatir daknyaa yuddhe capy apalayanam danam ecvara-bhavac ca knatraa karma svabhava-jam
translation: Heroism, power, determination, resourcefulness, courage in battle, generosity, and leadership are the qualities of work for the kñatriyas.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: kåñi-go-rakñya-väëijyaà vaiçya-karma svabhäva-jam paricaryätmakaà karma çüdrasyäpi svabhäva-jam
transliteration: kani-go-raknya-vaeijyaa vaicya-karma svabhava-jam paricaryatmakaa karma cudrasyapi svabhava-jam
translation: Farming, cattle raising and business are the qualities of work for the vaiçyas, and for the çüdras there is labor and service to others.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sve sve karmaëy abhirataù saàsiddhià labhate naraù sva-karma-nirataù siddhià yathä vindati tac chåëu
transliteration: sve sve karmaey abhiratau saasiddhia labhate narau sva-karma-niratau siddhia yatha vindati tac chaeu
translation: By following his qualities of work, every man can become perfect. Now please hear from Me how this can be done.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yataù pravåttir bhütänäà yena sarvam idaà tatam sva-karmaëä tam abhyarcya siddhià vindati mänavaù
transliteration: yatau pravattir bhutanaa yena sarvam idaa tatam sva-karmaea tam abhyarcya siddhia vindati manavau
translation: By worship of the Lord, who is the source of all beings and who is allpervading, man can, in the performance of his own duty, attain perfection.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çreyän sva-dharmo viguëaù para-dharmät sv-anuñöhität svabhäva-niyataà karma kurvan näpnoti kilbiñam
transliteration: creyan sva-dharmo vigueau para-dharmat sv-anunohitat svabhava-niyataa karma kurvan napnoti kilbinam
translation: It is better to engage in one’s own occupation, even though one may perform it imperfectly, than to accept another’s occupation and perform it perfectly. Prescribed duties, according to one’s nature, are never affected by sinful reactions.

glossary.gloss: prescribed duties according to one’s nature

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: saha-jaà karma kaunteya sa-doñam api na tyajet sarvärambhä hi doñeëa dhümenägnir ivävåtäù
transliteration: saha-jaa karma kaunteya sa-donam api na tyajet sarvarambha hi doneea dhumenagnir ivavatau
translation: Every endeavor is covered by some sort of fault, just as fire is covered by smoke. Therefore one should not give up the work which is born of his nature, O son of Kunté, even if such work is full of fault.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: asakta-buddhiù sarvatra jitätmä vigata-spåhaù naiñkarmya-siddhià paramäà sannyäsenädhigacchati
transliteration: asakta-buddhiu sarvatra jitatma vigata-spahau nainkarmya-siddhia paramaa sannyasenadhigacchati
translation: One can obtain the results of renunciation simply by self-control and by becoming unattached to material things and disregarding material enjoyments. That is the highest perfectional stage of renunciation.

glossary.gloss: control of the mind, vigata-spåhaù—without material desires
by the renounced order of life

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: siddhià präpto yathä brahma tathäpnoti nibodha me samäsenaiva kaunteya niñöhä jïänasya yä parä
transliteration: siddhia prapto yatha brahma tathapnoti nibodha me samasenaiva kaunteya ninoha jianasya ya para
translation: O son of Kunté, learn from Me in brief how one can attain to the supreme perfectional stage, Brahman, by acting in the way which I shall now summarize.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: buddhyä viçuddhayä yukto dhåtyätmänaà niyamya ca çabdädén viñayäàs tyaktvä räga-dveñau vyudasya ca
transliteration: buddhya vicuddhaya yukto dhatyatmanaa niyamya ca cabdaden vinayaas tyaktva raga-dvenau vyudasya ca
translation: Being purified by his intelligence and controlling the mind with determination, giving up the objects of sense gratification, being freed from attachment and hatred, one who lives in a secluded place, who eats little and who controls the body and the tongue, and is always in trance and is detached, who is without false ego, false strength, false pride, lust, anger, and who does not accept material things, such a person is certainly elevated to the position of selfrealization.

glossary.gloss: the sense objects, such as sound, etc.

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: vivikta-sevé laghv-äçé yata-väk-käya-mänasaù dhyäna-yoga-paro nityaà vairägyaà samupäçritaù
transliteration: vivikta-seve laghv-ace yata-vak-kaya-manasau dhyana-yoga-paro nityaa vairagyaa samupacritau
translation: Being purified by his intelligence and controlling the mind with determination, giving up the objects of sense gratification, being freed from attachment and hatred, one who lives in a secluded place, who eats little and who controls the body and the tongue, and is always in trance and is detached, who is without false ego, false strength, false pride, lust, anger, and who does not accept material things, such a person is certainly elevated to the position of selfrealization.

glossary.gloss: the sense objects, such as sound, etc.

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ahaìkäraà balaà darpaà kämaà krodhaà parigraham vimucya nirmamaù çänto brahma-bhüyäya kalpate
transliteration: ahaikaraa balaa darpaa kamaa krodhaa parigraham vimucya nirmamau canto brahma-bhuyaya kalpate
translation: Being purified by his intelligence and controlling the mind with determination, giving up the objects of sense gratification, being freed from attachment and hatred, one who lives in a secluded place, who eats little and who controls the body and the tongue, and is always in trance and is detached, who is without false ego, false strength, false pride, lust, anger, and who does not accept material things, such a person is certainly elevated to the position of selfrealization.

glossary.gloss: the sense objects, such as sound, etc.

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: brahma-bhütaù prasannätmä na çocati na käìkñati samaù sarveñu bhüteñu mad-bhaktià labhate paräm
transliteration: brahma-bhutau prasannatma na cocati na kaiknati samau sarvenu bhutenu mad-bhaktia labhate param
translation: One who is thus transcendentally situated at once realizes the Supreme Brahman. He never laments nor desires to have anything; he is equally disposed to every living entity. In that state he attains pure devotional service unto Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: bhaktyä mäm abhijänäti yävän yaç cäsmi tattvataù tato mäà tattvato jïätvä viçate tad-anantaram
transliteration: bhaktya mam abhijanati yavan yac casmi tattvatau tato maa tattvato jiatva vicate tad-anantaram
translation: One can understand the Supreme Personality as He is only by devotional service. And when one is in full consciousness of the Supreme Lord by such devotion, he can enter into the kingdom of God.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sarva-karmäëy api sadä kurväëo mad-vyapäçrayaù mat-prasädäd aväpnoti çäçvataà padam avyayam
transliteration: sarva-karmaey api sada kurvaeo mad-vyapacrayau mat-prasadad avapnoti cacvataa padam avyayam
translation: Though engaged in all kinds of activities, My devotee, under My protection, reaches the eternal and imperishable abode by My grace.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: cetasä sarva-karmäëi mayi sannyasya mat-paraù buddhi-yogam upäçritya mac-cittaù satataà bhava
transliteration: cetasa sarva-karmaei mayi sannyasya mat-parau buddhi-yogam upacritya mac-cittau satataa bhava
translation: In all activities just depend upon Me and work always under My protection. In such devotional service, be fully conscious of Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: mac-cittaù sarva-durgäëi mat-prasädät tariñyasi atha cet tvam ahaìkärän na çroñyasi vinaìkñyasi
transliteration: mac-cittau sarva-durgaei mat-prasadat tarinyasi atha cet tvam ahaikaran na cronyasi vinaiknyasi
translation: If you become conscious of Me, you will pass over all the obstacles of conditional life by My grace. If, however, you do not work in such consciousness but act through false ego, not hearing Me, you will be lost.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yad ahaìkäram äçritya na yotsya iti manyase mithyaiña vyavasäyas te prakåtis tväà niyokñyati
transliteration: yad ahaikaram acritya na yotsya iti manyase mithyaina vyavasayas te prakatis tvaa niyoknyati
translation: If you do not act according to My direction and do not fight, then you will be falsely directed. By your nature, you will have to be engaged in warfare.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: svabhäva-jena kaunteya nibaddhaù svena karmaëä kartuà necchasi yan mohät kariñyasy avaço ’pi tat
transliteration: svabhava-jena kaunteya nibaddhau svena karmaea kartua necchasi yan mohat karinyasy avaco 'pi tat
translation: Under illusion you are now declining to act according to My direction. But, compelled by your own nature, you will act all the same, O son of Kunté.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: éçvaraù sarva-bhütänäà håd-deçe ’rjuna tiñöhati bhrämayan sarva-bhütäni yanträrüòhäni mäyayä
transliteration: ecvarau sarva-bhutanaa had-dece 'rjuna tinohati bhramayan sarva-bhutani yantraruohani mayaya
translation: The Supreme Lord is situated in everyone’s heart, O Arjuna, and is directing the wanderings of all living entities, who are seated as on a machine, made of the material energy.

glossary.gloss: in the location of the heart
under the spell of material energy.

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: tam eva çaraëaà gaccha sarva-bhävena bhärata tat-prasädät paräà çäntià sthänaà präpsyasi çäçvatam
transliteration: tam eva caraeaa gaccha sarva-bhavena bharata tat-prasadat paraa cantia sthanaa prapsyasi cacvatam
translation: O scion of Bharata, surrender unto Him utterly. By His grace you will attain transcendental peace and the supreme and eternal abode.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: iti te jïänam äkhyätaà guhyäd guhyataraà mayä vimåçyaitad açeñeëa yathecchasi tathä kuru
transliteration: iti te jianam akhyataa guhyad guhyataraa maya vimacyaitad aceneea yathecchasi tatha kuru
translation: Thus I have explained to you the most confidential of all knowledge. Deliberate on this fully, and then do what you wish to do.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sarva-guhyatamaà bhüyaù çåëu me paramaà vacaù iñöo ’si me dåòham iti tato vakñyämi te hitam
transliteration: sarva-guhyatamaa bhuyau caeu me paramaa vacau inoo 'si me daoham iti tato vaknyami te hitam
translation: Because you are My very dear friend, I am speaking to you the most confidential part of knowledge. Hear this from Me, for it is for your benefit.

glossary.gloss: you are very dear to Me

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: man-manä bhava mad-bhakto mad-yäjé mäà namaskuru mäm evaiñyasi satyaà te pratijäne priyo ’si me
transliteration: man-mana bhava mad-bhakto mad-yaje maa namaskuru mam evainyasi satyaa te pratijane priyo 'si me
translation: Always think of Me and become My devotee. Worship Me and offer your homage unto Me. Thus you will come to Me without fail. I promise you this because you are My very dear friend.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: sarva-dharmän parityajya mäm ekaà çaraëaà vraja ahaà tväà sarva-päpebhyo mokñayiñyämi mä çucaù
transliteration: sarva-dharman parityajya mam ekaa caraeaa vraja ahaa tvaa sarva-papebhyo moknayinyami ma cucau
translation: Abandon all varieties of religion and just surrender unto Me. I shall deliver you from all sinful reaction. Do not fear.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: idaà te nätapaskäya näbhaktäya kadäcana na cäçuçrüñave väcyaà na ca mäà yo ’bhyasüyati
transliteration: idaa te natapaskaya nabhaktaya kadacana na cacucrunave vacyaa na ca maa yo 'bhyasuyati
translation: This confidential knowledge may not be explained to those who are not austere, or devoted, or engaged in devotional service, nor to one who is envious of Me.

glossary.gloss: one who is not a devotee
one who is not engaged in devotional service

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: ya idaà paramaà guhyaà mad-bhakteñv abhidhäsyati bhaktià mayi paräà kåtvä mäm evaiñyaty asaàçayaù
transliteration: ya idaa paramaa guhyaa mad-bhaktenv abhidhasyati bhaktia mayi paraa katva mam evainyaty asaacayau
translation: For one who explains the supreme secret to the devotees, devotional service is guaranteed, and at the end he will come back to Me.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: na ca tasmän manuñyeñu kaçcin me priya-kåttamaù bhavitä na ca me tasmäd anyaù priyataro bhuvi
transliteration: na ca tasman manunyenu kaccin me priya-kattamau bhavita na ca me tasmad anyau priyataro bhuvi
translation: There is no servant in this world more dear to Me than he, nor will there ever be one more dear.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: adhyeñyate ca ya imaà dharmyaà saàvädam ävayoù jïäna-yajïena tenäham iñöaù syäm iti me matiù
transliteration: adhyenyate ca ya imaa dharmyaa saavadam avayou jiana-yajiena tenaham inoau syam iti me matiu
translation: And I declare that he who studies this sacred conversation worships Me by his intelligence.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: çraddhävän anasüyaç ca çåëuyäd api yo naraù so ’pi muktaù çubhäl lokän präpnuyät puëya-karmaëäm
transliteration: craddhavan anasuyac ca caeuyad api yo narau so 'pi muktau cubhal lokan prapnuyat pueya-karmaeam
translation: And one who listens with faith and without envy becomes free from sinful reaction and attains to the planets where the pious dwell.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: kaccid etac chrutaà pärtha tvayaikägreëa cetasä kaccid ajïäna-sammohaù praëañöas te dhanaïjaya
transliteration: kaccid etac chrutaa partha tvayaikagreea cetasa kaccid ajiana-sammohau praeanoas te dhanaijaya
translation: O conqueror of wealth, Arjuna, have you heard this attentively with your mind? And are your illusions and ignorance now dispelled?
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: arjuna uväca nañöo mohaù småtir labdhä tvat-prasädän mayäcyuta sthito ’smi gata-sandehaù kariñye vacanaà tava
transliteration: arjuna uvaca nanoo mohau smatir labdha tvat-prasadan mayacyuta sthito 'smi gata-sandehau karinye vacanaa tava
translation: Arjuna said, My dear Kåñëa, O infallible one, my illusion is now gone. I have regained my memory by Your mercy, and I am now firm and free from doubt and am prepared to act according to Your instructions.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: saïjaya uväca ity ahaà väsudevasya pärthasya ca mahätmanaù saàvädam imam açrauñam adbhutaà roma-harñaëam
transliteration: saijaya uvaca ity ahaa vasudevasya parthasya ca mahatmanau saavadam imam acraunam adbhutaa roma-harnaeam
translation: Saïjaya said: Thus have I heard the conversation of two great souls, Kåñëa and Arjuna. And so wonderful is that message that my hair is standing on end.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: vyäsa-prasädäc chrutavän etad guhyam ahaà param yogaà yogeçvarät kåñëät säkñät kathayataù svayam
transliteration: vyasa-prasadac chrutavan etad guhyam ahaa param yogaa yogecvarat kaneat saknat kathayatau svayam
translation: By the mercy of Vyäsa, I have heard these most confidential talks directly from the master of all mysticism, Kåñëa, who was speaking personally to Arjuna.

glossary.gloss: from the master of all mysticism

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: räjan saàsmåtya saàsmåtya saàvädam imam adbhutam keçavärjunayoù puëyaà håñyämi ca muhur muhuù
transliteration: rajan saasmatya saasmatya saavadam imam adbhutam kecavarjunayou pueyaa hanyami ca muhur muhuu
translation: O King, as I repeatedly recall this wondrous and holy dialogue between Kåñëa and Arjuna, I take pleasure, being thrilled at every moment.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: tac ca saàsmåtya saàsmåtya rüpam aty-adbhutaà hareù vismayo me mahän räjan håñyämi ca punaù punaù
transliteration: tac ca saasmatya saasmatya rupam aty-adbhutaa hareu vismayo me mahan rajan hanyami ca punau punau
translation: O King, when I remember the wonderful form of Lord Kåñëa, I am struck with even greater wonder, and I rejoice again and again.
source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text

iast: yatra yogeçvaraù kåñëo yatra pärtho dhanur-dharaù tatra çrér vijayo bhütir dhruvä nétir matir mama
transliteration: yatra yogecvarau kaneo yatra partho dhanur-dharau tatra crer vijayo bhutir dhruva netir matir mama
translation: Wherever there is Kåñëa, the master of all mystics, and wherever there is Arjuna, the supreme archer, there will also certainly be opulence, victory, extraordinary power, and morality. That is my opinion.

glossary.gloss: the carrier of the bow and arrow

source: Bhagavad-gita As It Is verse text
